description:
## This is the life-changing opportunity you've been looking for.

Imagine a playground in Atlantic Canada

surrounded by fresh waterways on one side and the ocean on the other.

Horizon Health Network is currently seeking Geriatrician to join our teams in beautiful New Brunswick, Canada! We have Geriatrician opportunities available throughout our province.

## Why you should work here

New Brunswick offers a safe and welcoming community with a relaxed lifestyle and a true work-life balance, enriched by its diverse Indigenous, Anglophone, and Francophone heritage.

Horizon Health Network is the largest health authority in the region, employing dedicated professionals focused on delivering high-quality care. Our employees collaborate with community partners to provide accessible health programs and services to over half a million people through our 12 hospitals and more than 100 medical facilities and clinics.

## Incentives & Remuneration:

Successful applicants may be eligible to receive the following:

• Urban provincial Incentive of $50,000.00 with a 2-year return of service.

• Rural provincial incentive of $100,000.00 with a 4-year return of service.

• Moving expense reimbursement is also available.

This is a Salaried position; remuneration is based on the New Brunswick Medical Pay Plan. Salary includes benefits such as pension, medical education leave (10 days), vacation, sick time, and personal time off. Overhead and office expenses are covered as part of the clinical office environment. Additional remuneration is available for on-call and teaching responsibilities.

## Who you are

• You have a Medical Degree from a recognized medical school and postgraduate studies (residency and fellowship) in the field of Geriatrics.

• Candidates must be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick.

• Preference will be given to those who hold or are eligible for certification in Geriatric Medicine with the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada.

• Proficiency in English is required. Bilingual skills would be considered an asset.

## What you will do

This full-time clinical geriatrician will be incorporated into a well-established Geriatric Medicine service. Our inpatient and outpatient services are well supported with administrative and nursing staff and access to SW/OT/PT services. This clinical geriatrician will be participating in outpatient clinics, and on a rotational basis with other geriatricians, will provide consultation service to our hospitals.

We are affiliated with Dalhousie Medicine and Sherbrooke University and our active teaching program sees many medical students and residents. The geriatrician will also contribute to academic and teaching components of our service with opportunities for collaborative research. This opportunity offers a wonderful lifestyle with excellent balance between inpatient and outpatient care in a well supported, team-based, community care setting.

A typical workweek will consist of 37.5 hours, Monday to Friday 0830 – 1630.

## Interested? Apply Today!

To learn more, visit MyHorizonCareer.ca/physicians

## About Horizon's Recruitment Process

We thank all applicant who apply; however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted. All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Horizon's recruitment screening process may include language proficiency testing, clerical testing and/or behavioral assessment. If you are selected for testing, you will be contacted via the email address provided on your application. The official results will be shared with the candidate, Human Resources and the requesting manager electronically and language results will be placed on the personnel file for Horizon's hiring purposes.

## Diversity Statement

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.

The Lead Finance Specialist (Capital Projects & Fixed Assets) provides specialized financial leadership and oversight for capital projects, project accounting, capital assets, and related financial controls across the organization. This role is responsible for ensuring that project expenditures, capital investments, and fixed assets are accurately recorded, appropriately governed, and compliant with accounting standards, organizational policies, and internal control requirements.
As the primary finance lead for project accounting and fixed asset management, the role serves as a key advisor to Finance leadership and works closely with project teams, FP&A, operational leaders, procurement, technology, and finance system stakeholders. The Lead Finance Specialist supports informed decision-making through technical accounting guidance, financial governance, capital reporting, compliance oversight, and continuous improvement of project and asset accounting processes.

## In this role, you will :

## Capital Project Accounting & Governance

• Act as the primary finance lead for project accounting and capital investment accounting.

• Establish and maintain project financial structures, cost tracking frameworks, and accounting requirements.

• Review project expenditures and assess capitalization eligibility in accordance with accounting standards and organizational policies.

• Monitor project costs and capital spending to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

• Provide accounting guidance related to project costs, capitalization, amortization, disposals, and project close-out activities.

• Support development and maintenance of project accounting policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.

## Fixed Asset Management

• Maintain oversight of the full fixed asset lifecycle, including acquisitions, capitalization, transfers, disposals, impairments, and amortization.

• Ensure the completeness and accuracy of the fixed asset register.

• Review and reconcile capital asset and construction-in-progress balances.

• Support physical asset verification activities and asset reviews.

• Ensure asset records are supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.

## Compliance, Controls & Accounting Stewardship

• Ensure compliance with accounting standards, organizational policies, delegation authorities, and internal control requirements.

• Design, implement, and monitor controls related to project accounting and fixed assets.

• Maintain audit-ready documentation and accounting support.

• Coordinate responses to internal and external audit requests related to projects and capital assets.

• Identify control gaps, compliance risks, and opportunities for process improvement.

## D365 & Financial Process Ownership

• Act as Finance process owner for project accounting and fixed asset accounting within D365.

• Support system configurations, testing, enhancements, and process improvements affecting project and capital accounting.

• Partner with Finance Systems, IT, Procurement, and operational stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting, and process effectiveness.

• Develop and maintain accounting procedures, guidance materials, and training resources.

## Stakeholder Support & Continuous Improvement

• Provide technical accounting guidance to project managers, business leaders, and Finance partners.

• Support consistent application of capitalization policies and project accounting requirements across the organization.

• Develop reporting, reconciliations, and monitoring tools that strengthen financial governance.

• Recommend improvements to processes, controls, and reporting practices.

## What Success Looks Like in This Role

A successful Lead Finance Specialist (Capital Projects & Fixed Assets) will:

• Ensure capital projects and fixed assets are accurately accounted for and supported by appropriate documentation.

• Maintain a strong and effective control environment over project accounting and capital assets.

• Deliver timely, accurate, and reliable capital and fixed asset reporting.

• Be recognized as the organization's subject matter expert for project accounting and capital asset accounting.

• Support successful audits with minimal findings related to projects or fixed assets.

• Improve consistency, compliance, and governance across capital project processes.

• Partner effectively with FP&A, project sponsors, and operational leaders while maintaining accounting integrity.

## What we are looking for:

• 8-12 years of relevant experience in accounting, finance, capital project accounting, fixed assets, or financial management.

• CPA designation required.

• Strong knowledge of ASNPO and capital asset accounting requirements.

• Experience supporting large capital projects, technology implementations, ERP projects, or infrastructure investments.

• Experience with project accounting and fixed asset modules within ERP systems, preferably D365.

• Strong accounting, internal control, reconciliation, and audit support experience.

• Effective communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

description:
The Opportunity

Company, Department: NS Power, Energy Delivery Capital Execution

Position Title: Project Manager-Engineering

Location: Halifax, NS

Closing Date: October 9, 2026

As Project Manager, Engineering, you will lead capital projects that support the reliability of Nova Scotia's electrical substation infrastructure. From early project development and business case planning through engineering, construction, commissioning, and closeout, you will have the opportunity to guide complex projects through their full lifecycle and see the tangible results of your work.
Working with high and medium voltage substation infrastructure, you will bring together technical expertise, project leadership, and strong stakeholder collaboration to deliver projects safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget. You will partner with teams across Engineering, Field Operations, Control Center Operations, Asset Management, System Planning, Environmental Services, and Safety, while also coordinating with contractors and external stakeholders.

This is an opportunity for an experienced engineering and project management professional who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex challenges, and working collaboratively across disciplines. You will contribute directly to the successful delivery of reliability-focused capital investments while continuing to build your experience in a complex, regulated utility environment.

Key elements of this role include:

• Lead Substation Reliability Capital Projects involving high and medium voltage infrastructure, including transformers, switches, circuit breakers, reclosers, buswork, and related equipment.

• Manage projects from development and planning through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout, maintaining accountability throughout the full lifecycle.

• Develop project scopes, evaluate alternatives, and support economic and business case justification to help advance well-informed investment decisions.

• Drive successful project delivery by actively managing scope, schedules, budgets, costs, risks, and competing priorities.

• Provide financial oversight through effective budgeting, monitoring, forecasting, and cost control throughout project execution.

• Navigate regulatory governance requirements and ensure project scope and justification align with applicable regulatory and organizational standards.

• Bring together cross-functional teams and contractors to establish alignment, coordinate activities, resolve challenges, and keep projects moving forward.

• Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, to support successful project development and implementation.

• Champion a strong safety culture, with accountability for the safety of yourself, colleagues, and contractors working under your direction.

• Support responsible project delivery by ensuring environmental performance aligns with established environmental management processes and initiatives.

These skills will make you successful:

You combine strong engineering knowledge with practical project leadership and an ability to bring people together around shared outcomes. Your experience enables you to navigate complex projects while balancing technical, financial, regulatory, safety, and stakeholder considerations.

• A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, combined with full membership or eligibility for membership in Engineers Nova Scotia. An equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may also be considered.

• At least six years of demonstrated experience managing projects through planning and execution, with a strong understanding of the full project lifecycle.

• Strong project management capabilities and knowledge of formal project management methodologies.

• A demonstrated ability to keep projects on schedule, within scope, and within budget, while successfully managing multiple priorities.

• Sound financial management skills, including budgeting and project cost control.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, operational groups, contractors, customers, and other stakeholders.

• The ability to coordinate work and make progress in a complex, cross-functional environment.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel within Nova Scotia as required to support projects.

Experience with high or medium voltage electrical infrastructure and familiarity with a regulated utility environment would be valuable assets. PMP certification is also considered an asset.

We understand that experience comes in many forms, and we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. So, if your experience is close to what we've listed above, please consider applying.

If working in an innovative environment, challenging yourself, and shaping a cleaner energy future inspires you, we want to hear from you. Apply by October 9, 2026 and let us know why this role is right for you.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Our St. John's office is looking for a proactive, digitally confident and people-focused Administrative Assistant to serve as the operational backbone of our office and municipal engineering teams. This role is critical in helping busy project teams stay organized, informed, and ready to deliver important infrastructure projects throughout Newfoundland and Labrador.

This is a visible and important in-office role. You will be one of the first people our clients, visitors and team members meet, while also working behind the scenes to coordinate calendars, travel, meetings, project documents, office logistics and changing priorities.

You do not need an engineering background. We are more interested in how you approach work: whether you take initiative, learn new technology quickly, communicate warmly and professionally, remain composed when plans change and follow through on the details that help a busy team succeed.

If you enjoy helping people, solving everyday problems and becoming the person others trust to keep things moving, this could be an excellent opportunity to build a long-term career with a leading employee-owned consulting firm.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Act as the welcoming face of CBCL's St. John's office by creating a professional, positive and memorable experience for clients, vendors, visitors and team members.

• Manage incoming calls and enquiries and connect people with the appropriate team member.

• Coordinate meetings, shared calendars, client presentations, office events and changing schedules.

• Arrange travel and prepare clear itineraries for project managers and technical staff, including changes and expense documentation.

• Format and coordinate letters, reports, proposals, specifications and other project documents.

• Maintain organized digital project records, proposal trackers, filing systems and archives.

• Support meeting preparation, record key decisions and actions, and help ensure follow-up items are not lost.

• Support engineering and project management teams working on municipal infrastructure projects throughout Newfoundland and Labrador by helping coordinate the information, meetings, travel and documentation required to deliver successful projects.

• Keep shared office areas organized, welcoming and supplied, including coordinating routine office services and supplies.

• Assist with everyday workplace technology, such as meeting-room equipment, printer connections and basic software issues, escalating matters when appropriate.

• Look for practical ways to simplify administrative processes and improve how information is organized and shared.

Career Growth

• This role offers more than traditional administrative support. As your skills develop, you will have opportunities to take ownership of increasingly complex responsibilities including: project administration, proposal coordination, document control systems, office operations, event coordination, business development support and digital workplace initiatives. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our team and build a long-term career within a leading employee-owned engineering consulting firm.

• You will work closely with engineering and project teams, receive practical coaching and gain exposure to the systems and processes behind consulting projects across Newfoundland and Labrador.

Your Capabilities and Credentials:

• Experience in administration, office coordination, customer service, hospitality, project support or another role involving organization and frequent interaction with people.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Practical experience with Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint

• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technology, troubleshoot routine digital and office issues, and confidently adapt to new software, systems and processes.

Assets, Not Requirements:

• Previous experience in consulting, professional services, construction, architecture, engineering or a quality-managed environment would be helpful but is not required. We will provide training on our project processes and terminology.

• Experience in formatting and preparation of reports and proposals;

• Post-secondary education in office administration, business or a related area is an asset. An equivalent combination of education, customer-service experience, administrative experience and demonstrated digital capability will also be considered.

What we can offer you:

• A competitive compensation package effective on your first day of employment:
• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• CAAT Defined Benefit Pension Plan with employer contributions

• Generous vacation allowance commensurate with experience

• Maternity or Parental leave top-up

• Health spending account

• Wellness incentive

• Membership dues reimbursement

• Education and lifelong learning subsidization

• Community volunteering incentive

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Public transit subsidy

In addition to the above benefits, we offer:

• Ability to work paid overtime or bank time-in-lieu for future use;

• Diverse team with a wide range of experience and expertise;

• Exposure to a variety of projects;

• Support to develop skills and pursue projects related to your own interests;

• Collaboration between multiple disciplines and levels of expertise;

• Mentoring opportunities to foster your personal and professional development;

• Accessible and central offices in Atlantic Canada and Ottawa; and

• Access to training opportunities in areas ranging from technical development to leadership skills.

About Us

At CBCL our purpose is to create a positive and lasting impact on people and our planet. As an employee-owned firm, at CBCL, our people are everything. We are committed to promoting inclusivity and diversity for a workplace where everyone can thrive, and we build long-term relationships with our clients while providing them with innovative solutions.

We have earned recognition as one of Canada's Top 100 Employers and one of Canada's Best Managed Companies. Our multitalented group of professionals offer consulting in the Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater, Buildings, Industrial, and Earth and Environment sectors. We value our people, our communities, and our history and look forward to continuing our steady growth.

Along with our commitment to reducing our carbon footprint corporately, CBCL develops and implements sustainable engineering solutions that respect the current social and environmental impacts, as well as future implications of our designs.

CBCL operates from its offices in Halifax and Sydney, NS; Charlottetown, PE; Saint John, Fredericton and Moncton, NB; St. John's, NL, and Ottawa, ON.

CBCL Limited strives to provide a diverse workplace that is inclusive, accessible and celebrates individuals and what makes us unique. We are proud to be an employer partner with the Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion and Pride at Work.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace for all. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment or interview process, or while working with us, please email hr@cbcl.ca. We will work with you to meet your needs in a respectful and timely manner.

Our goal is to ensure every candidate has a fair opportunity to demonstrate their abilities. We value diverse perspectives and are dedicated to removing barriers that may prevent individuals from thriving in their roles.

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those applicants who are selected to interview will be contacted.

title: Primary Care Paramedic - 2025501
description:
## COMPETITION NUMBER

## 2025501

## POSITION TITLE

Primary Care Paramedic

## LOCATION

Saint-François, NB

## BARGAINING UNIT

NB Union – Specialized Health Care Professionals

## STATUS

Part time permanent

## HOURS OF WORK

Rotating days and nights, weekends, and statutory holidays. Subject to change due to operational requirements.

## ANTICIPATED START DATE

As soon as possible

## ANTICIPATED END DATE

Not applicable

## SALARY RANGE

As per collective agreement

## LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT

Written & Spoken competence in English or French is required.

## CLOSING DATE

This competition will remain open until filled.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centers around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's License (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Bridge Engineer (Senior or Intermediate level)
employer: GEMTEC Consulting Engineers and Scientists Limited
description:
Are you an experienced Bridge Engineer looking to progress your career? We're looking for an Intermediate or Senior Bridge Engineer to join our growing team. We are open to filling this position in any of our locations across the Atlantic provinces.

Reporting to the Structural Bridge Lead, you will play a key role in the technical delivery and management of bridge projects—from conceptual design and analysis to construction review and inspection. The successful candidate will have the opportunity of designing various structural systems out of steel, concrete, and timber, including the design of prestressed concrete, GFRP reinforced concrete, composite steel/concrete sections, and composite precast/cast-in-place sections.

You will have excellent opportunities to grow and develop your engineering skills with the company, as well as mentor Engineers-in-Training and junior Engineers.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm—not too big, not too small. We're large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers—without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

You're an ideal candidate if you have:

• Initiative to lead projects and drive tasks to completion.

• A collaborative mindset and enjoy working across multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality work.

• A commitment to mentoring others.

• A proactive approach to client communication and problem solving.

A typical day on the job might look like:

• Lead or support the design and analysis of bridge structures in steel, concrete, and timber, including prestressed and composite systems.

• Prepare and review contract documents, technical reports, and construction estimates.

• Conduct and oversee bridge condition assessments, inspections, and load ratings (including above and below water).

• Provide construction support services, including review of shop drawings, responses to RFIs, and on-site problem resolution.

• Coordinate and collaborate with multi-disciplinary project teams to ensure successful project delivery.

• Manage project schedules, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring compliance with client expectations and quality standards.

• Assist in business development activities, including preparation of proposals and participation in client meetings.

• Mentor and support junior and intermediate engineers, fostering technical growth within the team.

• Adhering to all company policies.

• Other duties as required.

The good stuff you get:

• Full-time (37.5 hours per week)

• Complete health & dental coverage including vision, paramedical services, and Teladoc

• Retirement planning made easier with a 5% employer match on your contributions

• Paid time off (vacation and sick days) plus Employee & Family Assistance Program when you need it

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and the New Year)

Your background and what you bring:

• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited University.

• Registered, or eligible for registration, as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) with the Association of Professional Engineers & Geoscientists of New Brunswick (APEGNB).

• 8+ years of progressive experience in bridge structural design, inspection, and construction support. Any other heavy civil experience such as with marine or dam structures will be viewed as an additional asset.

• Demonstrated experience with prestressed concrete, steel and composite structures, and timber systems.

• Working knowledge of relevant design codes and standards (CHBDC, CSA).

• Proficiency with structural analysis and design software such as SAFI, StructurePoint, WoodWorks, Microsoft Office is an asset.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and collaborate effectively with Clients, Contractors, and Colleagues.

• Valid driver's license and have access to a personal vehicle for work related travel

Interested individuals, click here to apply: https://gemtec.bamboohr.com/careers/309

Thank you for taking the time to consider GEMTEC. Only candidates proceeding to the next phase of the application process will be contacted at this time. We encourage you to connect with us on LinkedIn, even if this opportunity isn't for you, the next one might be!

Should you be selected for an interview and require accommodation of any kind, please kindly help us understand how we can help. Email HR@GEMTEC.ca

description:
Zone: Eastern Urban Zone

Primary Care Paramedic (3 positions)

Salary: CG-29 ($27.07 - $30.07 per hour)

Competition Number: VAC0004867

Posted Date: 2024-12-10

Closing Date: Open until filled.

Job Summary
The work of a Primary Care Paramedic involves operating an ambulance in responding to emergencies and routine calls and providing skilled basic and advanced emergency care to persons suffering from a variety of illnesses and injuries. The Primary Care Paramedic is required to assess, stabilize and report on the nature and severity of the illness or injury. Work is performed with considerable independence and is reviewed through observation, examination of records/reports and the presence or absence of valid complaints. Reports directly to the Operations Supervisors.

Job Demands
By applying for this job, you acknowledge an understanding that regular requirements and demands of this job include (but are not limited to):
Regularly lifts and moves patients and equipment (between 25-50 lbs.) and involved in heavy lifting/pushing/pulling of stretchers (100 lbs.) and patients.
Constantly stands, bends, stretches, kneels or pushes and pulls; sometimes in small and cramped spaces.
Constantly requires visual concentration or alertness to drive ambulances, complete site and patient assessments and to administer medications. Regularly there are time pressures in the pre-hospital emergency setting.
Regularly there is lack of control over work pace occurs due to the unpredictable situations during a medical emergency, or unpredictable call volume.

Job Qualifications
Graduation from high school or equivalent.
Completion of Primary Care Paramedic Program.
Registration with the Provincial Medical Oversight Program.
Possession of a valid Class 4 Driver’s License as issued by the Province of Newfoundland and Labrador.
Experience in Emergency Care is required.
A satisfactory record of work performance is required.

A satisfactory code of conduct, a driver’s abstract, original education documents, proof of registration and current CPR are conditions of employment. The applicant must also participate in a pre-placement capabilities test.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
Requisition ID: 2600

Why Choose IMP Aerospace & Defence:
IMP Aerospace & Defence is not only one of the leading companies in the Aerospace field, but we are also one of the most engaging and equality advocating companies to work for. We believe that regardless of where you work at IMP Aerospace & Defence, you are a part of our ever-growing team. IMP is able to achieve success through this teamwork mindset. That is why at IMP, you are not defined by your role.

Position Overview:
The Supply Chain Analyst will analyze, measure, report on, and improve all aspects of the supply chain process, from material demand to issue.

What You Will Do:
• Manage inventory control reorder point levels within MRP system based on historical data and production planning activity.

• Minimize material shortages to ensure production schedule is not negatively impacted.

• Minimize financial impact of inventory.

• Collaborate with other departments to maintain/improve cross functional communication and decision making.

• Develop and implement strategies to improve inventory turns.

• Ascertain root cause and implement preventative measures for material shortages.

• Take a proactive approach to identify and resolve inventory control issues before they occur.

• Monitor and report material department performance metrics.

• Monitor and report supplier performance metrics.

• Improve and maintain the integrity of material data within an MRP system.

• Identify, report, and take action to minimize dormant or excess inventory holdings.

• Ensure contractual obligations surrounding material sourcing are met.

• Active engagement with supply chain operational analyses and projects as recommended or required.

• Develop and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to supply chain

What You Will Bring:
• Bachelors Degree within an analytically focused discipline such as Industrial Engineering, Operations, or Business.

• Strong analytical skills, applicable to supply chain measurement and business process improvement

• Strong SQL and database skills

• Strong skills in business analytics tool, e.g., Microsoft Power BI

• High level of proficiency using Advanced Excel.

• Strong knowledge of MRP and Inventory Control practices.

• Strong communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Strong business process improvement & change management skills

• Comfort in communicating with individuals at all levels of the organization.

• Understanding of financial impacts of supply chain management / business decisions.

• Experience with JD Edwards or other ERP Systems preferred.

• Any related certification would be an asset but not mandatory, e.g., CPIM, P.Log, SCMP, P.Eng.

• Experience working in an industrial or manufacturing environment is preferred.

• Experience in aerospace industry is preferred.

• Must be eligible to meet requirements for Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP), U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Canadian government security clearances.

What We Will Do For You:
• All IMP's benefits become effective on your first day of work, regardless of your position.

• Employees are entitled to 3 paid personal days and 12 statutory holidays per year.

• We offer a comprehensive Benefits Package, including RRSP Program, Tuition Reimbursement Program, Long Service Awards, Volunteer Grant Program, Scholarship Program, and more!

IMP is committed to Employment Equity and our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels. We welcome applicants from Indigenous People, Visible Minority Groups, Persons with Disabilities and Women in occupations or positions where they are under-represented. If you are a member of one of these equity groups, you are encouraged to self identify on either your cover letter or resume.

The philosophy of a Family Care Team (FCT) is to deliver care that is patient-centered, comprehensive, team-based, culturally safe, coordinated, accessible, and focused on quality and safety. This philosophy supports providers and care teams to meet clients where they are using an inter-professional collaborative approach where care is provided in the right place, at the right time, by the right provider in a manner that best suits the client’s needs. The team will ensure clients are treated with respect, dignity, and compassion, and enable strong and trusting relationships with providers and staff. FCT’s will enable the delivery of a range of quality care for clients within their own communities while facilitating interdisciplinary work amongst healthcare providers. This position will be primarily based in the Mose Ambrose Clinic while supporting PHC services throughout the Coast of Bays. There is also housing available for this position.

Definition of work:
As part of the collaborative team, the Nurse Practitioner will be expected to practice to their full scope of practice in order to provide comprehensive assessment and care to clients and provide clinic leadership. The FCT aims to provide continuity of care to improve health outcomes and quality of life through client attachment and client paneling to clinic providers, with the support and wrap around services of the full team. The successful applicant works independently in diagnosing conditions, prescribing medications, performing or ordering diagnostic tests and treatments, evaluating treatments and providing follow-up care in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team. The Nurse Practitioner provides comprehensive and holistic nursing care to clients including health promotion, injury and illness treatment and prevention, supportive, curative and rehabilitative care in a primary care practice setting. The Nurse Practitioner will document using the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). In this leadership role, the Nurse Practitioner will contribute to the ongoing program development, implementation, and evaluation of the FCT including client and clinician engagement. The role will encompass participating in clinic evaluations and continuous quality improvement processes based upon current best practice guidelines. Flexible hours are required (combination of days, evenings, and weekends required). The Nurse Practitioner will report to the Regional Manager of Primary Health Care in the Central Zone. The Nurse Practitioner will be responsible for the delivery of a comprehensive range of services including but not limited to:

• Primary Health Care
• Long Term Care
• Personal Care Homes
• Community based settings
• Acute based settings

As an advanced practitioner, the Nurse Practitioner functions in the roles of practitioner, educator and leader. As governed by provincial regulations, he/she practices independently, collaborating with the primary care physicians in the area for issues outside the Nurse Practitioner scope of practice. Travel throughout the region may be required. The successful candidate must demonstrate an awareness of and be responsible for promoting and supporting person-and family-centered care, demonstrate a commitment to safety and partner with all team members to improve worker and patient safety by integrating safety into work practices, identifying risks and implementing improvements.

At Nova Scotia Power, we are committed to providing safe, reliable electricity so that our customers and communities can thrive. The Senior Manager, Substation Reliability is responsible for the strategic development, governance, and execution oversight of Nova Scotia Power's Substation Capital Investment Program.

This position provides leadership to a team of engineers, project managers and technical specialists responsible for project execution, capital planning, engineering design, protection and control coordination, and reliability improvement initiatives associated with the transmission and distribution substation fleet.

title: Director of Cybersecurity

• Conduct enterprise cybersecurity risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, privacy requirements, and industry standards.

• Lead cybersecurity audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing activities, and remediation programs.

• Guide identity and access management programs, including privileged access management and multi-factor authentication.

• Evaluate and implement cybersecurity technologies and tools.

## Leadership & Team Development

• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing cybersecurity team.

• Develop cybersecurity awareness and training programs across the organization.

• Manage cybersecurity budgets, resource planning, and vendor relationships.

• Foster a culture of security awareness throughout the business.

• 5+ years leading cybersecurity teams and enterprise security programs.

• Experience managing cybersecurity operations in complex, multi-site, or global organizations.

• Proven experience with incident response, risk management, cloud security, and regulatory compliance.

• CISSP or CISM preferred.

• CISA, CCSP, or GIAC considered an asset.

• Security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and SOC 2.

• Cloud security platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud).

• Identity and Access Management (IAM), SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence solutions.

• Data protection, privacy regulations, and cybersecurity compliance requirements.

## Leadership Competencies

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.

• Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.

• Ability to manage complex security incidents and make decisions under pressure.

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.

• Proven ability to influence organizational change and drive security maturity.

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

title: Configuration Management Specialist
description:
PAL Aerospace is proud to partner with SkyAlyne , the prime contractor for the Future Aircrew Training ( FAcT ) Program—Canada's next-generation training initiative for the Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF). This transformative program will redefine how Canada trains its pilots, Air Combat Systems Officers (ACSOs), and Airborne Electronic Sensor Operators (AES Ops) through a powerful blend of live flying, advanced simulation, and classroom instruction.

At PAL Aerospace, you'll be part of a team where your expertise is valued, your career development is supported, and your contributions will have a lasting impact.

This role will report to the Vice President of Systems Engineering from any of our offices in Ottawa ON, Vaughan ON, Halifax NS, or St. John's NL.

The Configuration Management Specialist will work closely with the Programs, Engineering, Systems Engineering & Integration, Technical Services, IT, Supply Chain Management, and other non-technical PAL departments like Human Resources and Security to establish a baseline and maintain the configuration of the assets and services during program execution.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining configuration systems for Programs, ensuring processes and procedures are well documented, and internal training has been developed, including defining/updating Configuration Management Processes and Procedures.

• Manage and maintain the technical configuration baselines for aircraft, mission systems, software, support equipment, and associated technical data across development, modification, deployment, product management, and in-service sustainment.

• Maintain the product breakdown structure (PBS) and controlled configuration items (CIs), including hardware, software, firmware, interfaces, documents, and support data; establish unique identifiers, hierarchy, and baseline release rules.

• Support change impact analysis as part of the larger PAL Aerospace change management processes.

• Manage Configuration Control Boards (CCB) and enact changes as directed.

• Manage approved/released design and airworthiness data under configuration control, including drawings, specifications, ICDs, software version descriptions, manuals, ICA/AFMS supplements as applicable, and compliance evidence packages.

• Coordinate CM requirements with suppliers and subcontractors, including contractual flow down, baseline data acceptance, and incorporation of supplier changes into the PAL-controlled baseline.

• Plan and conduct configuration verification and audits, including functional/physical configuration audits, data audits, implementation audits, and re-baselining after modification, technical refresh , or service-life extension activities.

• Provide authoritative configuration status accounting and metrics to leadership, programs, engineering, systems, maintenance, and customers, including change aging, audit closure, baseline accuracy, and fleet embodiment status.

• Review and recommend CM tools, in addition to processes, procedures, etc.

• Ensure training and mentoring is provided to the organization on the Program's CM services, concepts, policies, and procedures.

• Contribute to PAL's QA and Technical Records processes.

• Support continuous improvement of processes.

• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• 10+ years' experience in aerospace, engineering, or related field where configuration control is tightly managed.

• 5+ years' experience working in an Engineering or technical design environment.

• 5+ years' experience in aerospace industry, knowledge of aircraft systems.

• Demonstrated knowledge of CM standards and systems engineering practice (e.g., INCOSE), including ISO 10007, SAE/EIA-649 family, and the five CM functions.

• Working knowledge of civil/military airworthiness change processes, especially Transport Canada CAR 521 and equivalent FAA/EASA Part 21 concepts for design changes and ICA.

• Experience controlling aircraft and mission-system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, drawings, software versions, part numbers, serial effectivity, and technical publications.

• Experience leading or facilitating CCBs and configuration audits in a cross-functional environment involving engineering, programs, quality, logistics, supply chain, and operations/maintenance.

• Experience with multi-disciplinary, high-performing system or product development teams.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in dealing with clients, internal and external stakeholders, senior management, and staff including both technical and non-technical individuals.

• Working knowledge of ISO 10007 is an asset.

• Desirable experience with AS9100/quality-system familiarity and documented-information/change-control discipline.

Security Responsibilities:

Incumbent must be able to obtain the required level of Government of Canada Personnel Security Clearance and to be able to be approved for the Canadian Controlled Goods program.

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Emergency Medical Care Inc. (EMC) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Medavie Health Services (MHS) that manages and operates ground ambulance, air medical transport and the medical communications operations in Nova Scotia through a performance-based contract with the provincial government's Emergency Health Services (EHS) Operations division and the Department of Health and Wellness. About Us
The Nova Scotia Public Prosecution Service (PPS) was established in 1990 as the first statutorily based independent prosecution service in Canada. The Public Prosecution Service is responsible for all prosecutions and appeals within the jurisdiction of the Attorney General.
With the guiding mission of providing fair and equal treatment in the prosecution of offences, the PPS prosecutes charges laid under the Criminal Code and under Nova Scotia statutes such as the Occupational Health and Safety Act. The Head Office is in Halifax and there are regional offices located throughout the province.
The core functions of the Nova Scotia Public Prosecution Service are to:

• Represent the Crown in the conduct of criminal trials and quasi-criminal appeals before all levels of courts

• Participate in the development of criminal law and criminal prosecutions policy

• Provide advice to police in respect of prosecutions generally or in respect of specific investigations

For more information on the Public Prosecution Service please visit https://novascotia.ca/pps/

About Our Opportunity
Under the direction of the Supervisor, Support Services the Legal Services Technician 3 (Paralegal) is responsible for triaging files, determining relevant documents, legal research, preparation of legal documents and correspondence, file management and organization, and other administrative functions and duties as assigned.

Primary Accountabilities
The Legal Services Technician is responsible for providing Crown Attorneys with legal research and a variety of case management services, as well as the preparation and processing of legal documents and correspondence. The Legal Services Technician utilizes law libraries and online legal research tools such as QuickLaw, Westlaw and CanLii. The Legal Services Technician prepares comprehensive legal memoranda for the benefit of Crown Attorneys at the pre-trial, trial and appellate stages of proceedings. The Legal Services Technician is responsible for case management of large files and file management of ongoing advice and prosecution files. The Legal Services Technician works collaboratively as part of the support team to assist with other administrative functions and duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Experience
Successful completion of a two-year Legal Services Technician course or Paralegal technology course from a recognized institution with 6 years' verifiable experience, some of which has been in the areas of regulatory and criminal law. An acceptable equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.
A thorough knowledge of the Criminal Code, Provincial statutes and regulations relating to the environment, public health, animal welfare, food safety, aquaculture and wildlife, Summary Proceedings Act, and the Crown Lands Act, as well as having the ability to research legislative history is required.
You possess working knowledge of the criminal court process, in particular prosecutions procedures, including working with legal documents and forms, court proceedings and legal terminology as required. You demonstrate an understanding of law libraries with the capability to use online legal research databases and library protocols as required. You have excellent oral and written communications skills, a high degree of initiative, substantial problem-solving capability and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. You have the ability to work accurately in a highly time sensitive environment utilizing sound judgement, strong organizational and prioritization skills.
We will assess the above qualifications and competencies using one or more of the following tools: written examination, standardized tests, oral presentations, interview(s), and reference checks.

title: Project Scheduler
description:
## Company

A proud member of the Exchange Income Corporation (EIC) family of companies, PAL Aerospace is a Canadian-owned and operated global aerospace and defence company. With a focus on intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance, in-service support solutions, aircraft engineering and modification and crew resource management training. PAL Aerospace is internationally recognized by governments, militaries, and industry for on time/on budget delivery and high reliability rates. PAL Aerospace offers a single point of accountability for its programs and takes pride in being the trusted choice for clients worldwide.

## Role Overview

The PAL Aerospace Programs Department is searching for a Full-Time Fixed Term Project Scheduler to join our team based in St. John's, NL. This is a crucial role in ensuring the smooth execution of our aircraft modification programs. The Scheduler will report to the Program Manager and support the program administrative functions, with an emphasis on scheduling. Due to the wide geographic dispersion of PAL's operations and the large nature of company programs, communication and organization are two core competencies that will help facilitate success in the Scheduler role.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Project Scheduling

• Support the decomposition of project scope and development of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).

• Collaborate and assist in the development of the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) at the scale of > 1,000 lines and activities, each with interdependencies.

• Regularly facilitate and incorporate divisional updates into the IMS.

• Develop and present Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) on project progress.

• Analyze project critical path and provide recommendations for improvement, compression, or risk reduction, as needed.

Team Coordination

• Liaise between technical staff (software, engineering, maintenance technicians), departmental management, project management team, clients, and finance to support project efforts.

• Effectively communicate in English, verbally and written, both in-person and via online meetings.

• Hosts interdepartmental working groups to develop project plans, facilitate updates, understand issues or delays, and baseline documents.

Risk Management

• Collaborate with the Project Manager (PM) to identify, assess, prioritize, respond, and communicate risks.

• Develop and manage the risk management database throughout the project lifecycle.

• Incorporate risk treatment strategies in IMSs.

Documentation Management

• Support the Project Manager in developing and baselining critical project documents.

• Carry out configuration management.

Qualifications:

• Post-secondary degree or diploma in Engineering, Business Administration, and/or an Aviation Business background is considered an asset.

• Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar training is considered an asset.

• For non-Canadian residents, an International English Language Testing System (IELTS) score ? Level 7.5, or equivalent evaluation program is required.

• A minimum of three (3) years of direct work experience in technical and/or aerospace program management is preferred.

• Proficient with Microsoft Project.

• Experience working with SSI tools considered an asset.

• Proficient with the Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Visio, SharePoint, and Power BI.

• Experience with requirements management software such as Jama, DevOps, IBM DOORS, or similar.

• Understanding of industry scheduling standards or best practices concepts, including but not limited to:
• Department of Defense (DoD) Integrated Master Plan and Integrated Master Schedule Preparation and Use Guide.

• National Defense Industrial Association (NDIA) Planning & Scheduling Excellence Guide (PASEG).

• High executive function with ability to logically organize, sequence, and present project work.

• Strong problem identification and resolution skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills.

• Ensure all ambulances and company vehicles based out of the Fleet centre are stocked

description:

title: Federal-Provincial-Territorial Secreteriat Opportunity (PB4/5)
description:
NEW BRUNSWICK HOUSING CORPORATIONEXPRESSION OF INTEREST:Pay Band 4/5Open Competition - Temporary Opportunity Federal-Provincial-Territorial Secretariat Opportunity

Housing New Brunswick (HNB) is seeking expressions of interest from Pay Band 4 and 5 employees for roles in contributing to the development of an FPT Secretariat. Over the next few years, HNB will be preparing to assume a stronger leadership role in FPT housing collaboration, requiring strong coordination, policy analysis, strategic advice, and relationship management across many levels of government. This initiative aims to identify employees for temporary assignments, projects, development opportunities, or future roles within the evolving Secretariat.

## About the Opportunity:

The FPT Secretariat will help advance New Brunswick`s housing priorities through effective intergovernmental coordination, clear advice to senior leaders, and timely support for national and regional housing discussions. The Secretariat will work closely with HNB teams, partners across the Government of New Brunswick, federal departments and other provinces and territories.

This is an opportunity to gain exposure to high-priority intergovernmental work, strengthen briefing and policy skills, and contribute directly to Housing New Brunswick`s readiness for future FPT leadership responsibilities while helping to shape a team that will become increasingly important to the organization over the coming years.

## Key Areas of Work:

Employees selected through this process may support a range of activities, including but not limited to:

• Support preparation for FPT, Provinces and Territories (PT), Assistant Deputy Minister (ADM), Deputy Minister and Minister-level meetings, including briefing notes, speaking notes, agendas, decision materials, and follow-up summaries.

• Leadership and collaboration on national working groups, including organizing facilitating and driving the agenda for multi-jurisdictional meetings to align strategic housing initiatives across regions.

• Development and delivery of high impact presentations for senior executives, intergovernmental partners, and stakeholder forums. Presentations must effectively communicate key insights, progress metrics, and strategic opportunities, and should reflect a high standard of analytical and visual clarity.

• Track federal, provincial and territorial housing developments, commitments, risks and opportunities relevant to New Brunswick.

• Coordinate input from HNB divisions and other departments to support clear and consistent provincial positions.

• Assist with federal agreement management, action plans, reporting, claims, performance tracking and related governance materials.

• Cross-jurisdictional analysis and reporting: includes performing in-depth jurisdictional analysis of housing policies, funding allocations, and performance outcomes and will involve synthesizing complex data sets to provide evidence-based insights and recommendations to senior leadership and working groups.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external partners.

## Need to have:

• A bachelor`s degree in business, sociology, or a related field and four (4) or five (5) years of related work experience. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Written and spoken competence in English and French is required. Some positions only require English. Please state your language capability.

Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration. Please ensure that preferred language for assessment is identified on your resume.

Behavioral Competencies: The successful candidate will possess the following leadership competencies:

• Strategic Thinking

• Effective Interactive Communication

• Relationship / Network Building

• Analytical Thinking/Judgment

• Organizational Awareness

Technical Competencies: The successful candidate will possess the following technical competencies:

• Policy and Research Analysis

• Planning and Organizing Skills

• Written Communication

• Consulting Skills

• Project Management

## Who Should Apply

This opportunity may be a good fit for employees who are curious, organized, collaborative and interested in housing policy, federal funding programs and intergovernmental work, even if they do not have direct FPT experience. title: Registered Nurse (Part-Time)
description:
Are you a Registered Nurse who enjoys working in a fast-paced surgical environment while making a meaningful impact on the patient experience? Jackman Eye Institute is looking for a compassionate and highly organized Registered Nurse (Part-Time) to join our surgical team in a part-time role. As the circulating nurse, you will serve as the patient's advocate throughout their surgical journey while ensuring the safe, efficient, and seamless operation of the operating room.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys a balance of direct patient care, clinical coordination, documentation, and collaboration with surgeons and the surgical team.

The Perks of Joining Our Team.
• Work in a positive, collaborative environment that values teamwork and continuous learning.

• Participate in staff events.

• Uniforms provided to maintain a professional appearance.

• Flexible part-time schedule.

What You'll Do
• Serve as the circulating nurse during surgical procedures, ensuring patient safety and advocating for patient needs throughout the surgical experience.

• Prepare patients for surgery by providing education, answering questions, and helping to reduce anxiety.

• Maintain comprehensive and accurate nursing documentation and health records in accordance with professional standards and regulatory requirements.

• Monitor and maintain a safe, sterile surgical environment while ensuring compliance with infection prevention and control practices.

• Collaborate closely with surgeons, technicians, and other members of the clinical team throughout procedures.

• Monitor patients during procedures, recognize changes in patient condition, and respond appropriately to emergencies.

• Participate in emergency response situations and provide clinical support as required.

• Assist with post-operative recovery, patient monitoring, discharge instructions, and communication with family members when appropriate.

• Support quality assurance initiatives, accreditation standards, and continuous quality improvement activities.

What You'll Bring
• Previous operating room, ambulatory surgery, ophthalmology, or day surgery experience is considered an asset.

• Strong understanding of perioperative nursing principles, patient safety, and infection prevention practices.

• Excellent assessment, clinical judgment, and critical thinking skills.

• Strong organizational and time management abilities with the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced surgical environment.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a patient-centered approach.

• Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions during urgent or emergency situations.

• Experience with electronic medical records (EMR)

• Current CPR/BLS certification. ACLS certification is considered an asset.

Jackman Eye Institute is committed to delivering exceptional ophthalmic care in an innovative, patient-focused environment. Our team is dedicated to transforming lives through improved vision while fostering a workplace built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous learning.

description:
Sales & Marketing Coordinator

Designated office:

6080 Young Street

Halifax, NS

This position is:

On-site - working all 5 days per week in the Office

Reporting To: Manager Partner & Maritimes Sales

The Sales & Marketing Coordinator supports the execution of consumer sales and regional marketing initiatives through administrative coordination, event support, marketing material management, sales reporting, and data administration. This role is responsible for ensuring consumer sales teams have the tools, resources, and information needed to drive business growth. The successful candidate will combine strong organizational skills with analytical capabilities to support both day-to-day operations and strategic decision-making.

Responsibilities:

Event & Home Show Coordination

• Assist in the planning, organization, and execution of regional home shows, community events, and sales events.

• Attend events and home shows as a representative of Eastlink.

• Coordinate event logistics, including booth setup, materials, staffing schedules, registrations, and post-event follow-up.

• Ensure sales teams have the required marketing materials and support to maximize event effectiveness.

• Track event performance, team feedback, and sales breakage.

Sales Analysis & Reporting

• Collect, analyze, and report on sales performance data across the region.

• Prepare regular sales reports and dashboards utilizing internal reporting systems.

• Monitor channel metrics and targets, and identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Support territory analysis and sales performance evaluations.

• Provide actionable insights to assist sales decision-making.

Data Management

• Create and maintain reporting tools and databases to support sales and marketing activities.

• Generate reports and analytics to support business planning and performance measurement.

• Contribute ideas to improve sales processes.

Marketing & Administrative Support

• Coordinate and administer regional marketing activities.

• Order, track, and distribute marketing materials, promotional items, signage, and sales collateral to regional sales teams.

• Maintain inventory of marketing assets and ensure materials are current and available.

• Coordinate vendor relationships related to promotional products, print materials, and event resources.

• Work in partnership with National Marketing on marketing calendars and coordinate project timelines.

Skills & Competencies:

• Strong organizational and project coordination skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and present data.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong customer service mindset and professional demeanor.

Working Conditions:

• Primarily office-based with occasional travel within the region.

• Participation in evening and weekend events, and home shows as required.

• Valid driver's license and access to reliable transportation may be required.

Key Success Measures:

• Timely and accurate delivery of marketing materials and sales support resources.

• Successful coordination and execution of regional events and home shows.

• Accuracy and integrity of sales and customer data.

• Quality and timeliness of sales reporting and analysis.

• Positive support and service provided to consumer sales teams and regional leadership.

About Eastlink

Eastlink is proudly family-owned and headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia. After more than 50 years, we’ve grown from a small-town startup into one of Canada’s Best Managed companies without losing our entrepreneurial edge. We move fast. We try new things. We care about doing right by our customers, and we’re not afraid to take a different approach to make that happen.

Why Work With Us

We could say we’re not your typical telecom, but what makes us different is how we operate day to day. At Eastlink, we’re a tight-knit team all working toward common goals. We’re big enough to do meaningful work, but small enough that you can actually make your mark. You won’t get stuck waiting for layers of approval or years of tenure to make an impact! We believe in getting involved, speaking up, and figuring things out together. We’re always listening, learning, and adapting because our customers (and our people) expect us to. And just like we invest in our network, we invest in you, with intention and for the long run.

We’re committed to building a workplace where everyone feels they belong. We embrace diversity, inclusion, equity, and accessibility throughout all levels of the organization and encourage members of equity groups to self-identify during the application process.

Get your career started with us and stay with us, your journey begins here!

title: Innu Employment Coordinator
description:
Who We Are
We are Vale Base Metals – a global supplier of the critical minerals transforming the future.

With industry-leading reserves of copper and nickel in Canada, Brazil, and Indonesia, and state-of-the-art infrastructure in the U.K., Canada, and Japan, VBM delivers a secure and responsible supply of high-quality products to customers across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Global demand for critical minerals is growing exponentially. From energy to aerospace, batteries to magnets, robotics to artificial intelligence, a secure and responsible supply of critical minerals is fundamental to power modern technologies. And at Vale Base Metals, we are transforming our business to provide a secure and responsible supply of these minerals.

Join our diverse team of 13,000 talented individuals committed to providing mineral security to a world in transition. We invite you to put your skills to work, driving meaningful and enduring change while enjoying a rewarding career.

## The Opportunity

We are currently seeking an Innu Employment Coordinator to join our People and Community team in Voisey's Bay, Labrador, a fly-in fly-out operation.

This is a permanent position, working a Monday to Friday schedule with regular travel to the Voisey's Bay Mine Site and Innu communities within Labrador.

As an Innu Employment Coordinator, you will play an integral part in supporting the hiring and training preferences for Innu Nation Members. The primary objective of the role is to ensure that qualified Indigenous candidates are given first consideration for all employment and training opportunities at the Voisey's Bay Mine Site as it relates to the Impacts and Benefits Agreement (IBA) with Innu Nation.

Additionally, in this position you will:

• Assist with recruitment efforts to hire Innu Nation members for job openings and training opportunities at the Voisey's Bay Mine Site.

• Assist the Talent Acquisition team and site Contractors in identifying qualified Indigenous employees.

• Attend all Innu candidate's interviews to ensure comfort, accuracy and consistency in the recruitment and selection process; and provide translation in Innu Amun to candidates where necessary.

• Assist in coordinating and facilitating events onsite in Voisey's Bay and Innu communities.

title: Court Stenographer
description:
Court Stenographer Court ServicesJustice and Public SafetyPermanent - OPENBilingualCampbellton, NB

Interested in making a difference in our province? We encourage you to Choose GNB!

## Who we are

The Department of Justice and Public Safety is dedicated to upholding the law, advocating for the greater good, and ensuring justice is served impartially. We're committed to strengthening the safety, security, and resilience of communities and citizens.

Our work has a positive impact on our communities and helps improve the everyday lives of New Brunswickers. Together, we are over 45,000 public servants who are passionate problem-solvers, who make a difference and are proud to call New Brunswick home.

The Department of Justice and Public Safety is seeking an individual to join the Court Services Branch as a Court Stenographer working in Campbellton, NB

## What does a Court Stenographer Do?

As a Court Stenographer, you'll be at the heart of the judicial process, playing an essential role in attending court and recording evidence, transcribing, preparing legal documents, and providing support to the judiciary and to court participants. It's a chance to be part of something meaningful, and to gain practical experience in the New Brunswick justice system. As a court stenographer, you will be an integral part of a vital institution that upholds the principles of fairness, impartiality, and the rule of law.

What's in it for You?

Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for professional development, training, and advancement within the department. Learn about the inner workings of the legal system in New Brunswick - A fantastic opportunity for those who are interested in a career in the justice system or who are aspiring to pursue a law degree in the future.

Competitive Salary: Earn between $2,361.74- $2,731.47 biweekly ($61,405.24-$71,018.22 annually).

Comprehensive Benefits: Access a comprehensive benefits package, including the Public Service Shared Risk Pension Plan, and free Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) services.

A safe workplace for all: Your health & safety are important to us. GNB has implemented preventative measures across the organization to ensure your health & safety.

Paid Vacation: 1.25 days of paid vacation per month.

## Who We're Looking For

We're seeking individuals with initiative, flexibility, a passion for order, effective communication skills, and the ability to work under pressure. An individual who can thrive in an environment using technology (including video conferencing and Teams) will be the best fit for this role. Whether you're a seasoned administrative professional or a legal enthusiast looking to make your mark, we want to hear from you!

## Work environment

• Office location: Campbellton Law Courts, NB

• Standard hours of work: Monday - Friday, 8:15-4:30 with weekend rotations for remand court (see myth/fact below)

• Occasional work outside normal working hours: (Sometimes court can sit over a noon hour or past 4:30, but we offer overtime, time off in lieu).

• Occasional travel within the region when required. (Expenses covered as per the GNB Travel policy)

Facts and Myths about the court stenographer role:

Myth: You need to transcribe during a hearing, and type everything in shorthand.

Fact: You do not transcribe while court is in session (no transcribing in real-time), and you do not need to know shorthand (it`s not like the movies anymore!). Only a regular keyboard is used, and you are not tested on words per minute.

Myth: All stenographers work every weekend.

Fact: Weekend remand court runs every Saturday and Sunday (and Statutory holidays), on a rotational basis in only one (1) of eight (8) judicial districts across the province. Two (2) stenographers are paid overtime for the hours worked during weekend. These shifts are filled on a volunteer basis.

Myth: A court stenographer is in court all day everyday with no flexibility and works routinely after hours.

Fact: There is a good mix of office work and court sitting days. A court stenographer is not always in court every day each week. There are days when court might sit longer than usual, however we work as a team and one stenographer may replace another when needed.

• High School Diploma or GED.

Successful candidates will be required to undergo a criminal history clearance and security clearance check.

An equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

The ability to transcribe from digital audio files is required. As such, you will be required to successfully complete the Department`s court transcription test in English and/or French. (you are not tested on speed of typing).

Written and spoken competence in English and spoken competence in French is required, please state your language capability
