title: Director of Municipal Performance
description:
## SUMMARY

Reporting to the Deputy Chief Administrative Officer, Organizational Services, the incumbent plays a corporate, cross-functional role aimed at developing and strengthening the City of Dieppe's capacity to improve its practices, deliver corporate projects, measure its performance and achieve its strategic priorities.

The Director of Municipal Performance establishes and leads an integrated department encompassing organizational transformation, corporate project management, change management, process optimization, continuous improvement-particularly through the "Amélioration Dieppe" program-as well as performance measurement and accountability mechanisms.

Working with the Deputy Chief Administrative Officer, departments and managers, the incumbent serves as a strategic and operational partner. The incumbent translates strategic directions into concrete action, supports their implementation and helps embed a structured, engaging and results-oriented organizational culture.

## RESPONSIBILITIES

## Organizational performance and decision-making support

• Design, implement and continuously improve an integrated municipal performance management system

• Develop performance management methodologies and monitoring tools, as well as indicators for measuring results

• Analyze organizational data, interpret results and prepare strategic reports to support decision-making

• Make recommendations to improve performance and organizational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives

• Monitor organizational performance, assess progress and recommend required adjustments

• Embed an organizational culture focused on results, accountability, continuous improvement and evidence-based decision-making

## Strategic planning

• Support senior management in implementing, monitoring and continuously developing strategic planning

• Coordinate the strategic planning cycle, including annual planning, periodic reviews and accountability mechanisms

• Ensure organizational initiatives are aligned with the City's strategic directions and objectives

• Advise departments to ensure their action plans, projects and priorities are aligned with the City's strategic plan

• Identify gaps, interdependencies, risks and capacity issues, and recommend required adjustments

• Prepare strategic reports, when required, for senior management, City Council and the public, including progress reports issued twice a year

## Organizational transformation, corporate projects and organizational change

• Lead the delivery of corporate and cross-functional projects, ensuring their planning, coordination and monitoring, the application of their governance mechanisms and the achievement of expected results

• Define and clarify the objectives, deliverables, timelines, roles, responsibilities, risks, interdependencies and expected benefits of corporate projects

• Implement and continuously improve project management approaches suited to the municipal context

• Assess the human, organizational, operational and technological impacts of transformation projects, as well as organizational capacity issues

• Anticipate resistance and risks related to buy-in, and recommend the measures required to secure that buy-in

• Develop and implement integrated change management, communication, training and support strategies

• Support departments and managers in fulfilling their roles as change leaders in order to foster smooth and sustainable transitions

• Ensure the sustained adoption of new practices, processes and ways of working

## Continuous improvement

• Provide advisory expertise to senior management, departments and managers to support the integration of a continuous improvement culture

• Work with departments to identify and prioritize opportunities for improvement, assess needs and guide interventions based on organizational issues

• Analyze issues experienced by work teams, conduct the required assessments and make recommendations to improve processes, organizational efficiency and the City's overall performance

• Facilitate the resolution of cross-departmental issues that could hinder progress on improvement initiatives

• Conduct or coordinate performance, efficiency and cost-effectiveness audits and prepare appropriate reports and recommendations

• Ensure the continued development, governance and sustainability of the "Amélioration Dieppe" program, based on the Lean Six Sigma approach, by updating its framework, objectives, service offerings and monitoring mechanisms

• Monitor trends, emerging practices and best practices in continuous improvement and change management, and recommend their adoption

## Human, financial and administrative resources

• Provide strategic management of team members, including workforce planning, skills development, performance management, occupational health and safety, and maintaining a healthy work environment, in collaboration with the Human Resources Department

• Lead, engage and support team members to foster accountability, commitment and achievement of the department's objectives

• Plan, manage and monitor the department's financial resources, including operating and capital budgets, in accordance with the City's directions and policies

• Ensure a rigorous, transparent and compliant management of administrative resources, contracts, procurement processes, agreements and funding requests

• Oversee the preparation of funding and grant applications, as well as the related reporting requirements

• Ensure optimal use of the department's human, financial and material resources, and recommend the necessary adjustments to ensure the department's performance, efficiency and sustainability

## Other

• Perform any other related duties, including but not limited to those assigned by the Deputy Chief Administrative Officer

## MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

## Education and certifications

• Bachelor's degree in public administration, business administration, organizational development or another relevant discipline

• An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

• Recognized project management certification - for example, PMP, PRINCE2 or another equivalent certification or training

• Recognized Lean facilitation certification, such as a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Lean Master certification or equivalent (considered an asset)

• Change management certification, such as PROSCI, Lean, Agile or another relevant recognized certification or training (considered an asset)

## Experience

• Seven (7) years of relevant experience, including significant experience in management, leadership or strategic advisory roles

• Experience in strategic planning, organizational performance management, continuous improvement, process optimization, problem-solving, and corporate or cross-functional project management

• Experience in organizational transformation, change management and supporting managers (considered an asset)

• Experience in a municipal, quasi-public or public-sector organization (considered an asset)

## Knowledge

• Proficiency in spoken and written French and English

• Very good knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint

• In-depth knowledge of project management and change management principles, methods and tools

• Good knowledge of continuous improvement approaches, including Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S, as well as process optimization and problem-solving methods

• Good knowledge of the principles and practices of strategic planning, organizational performance management, indicator development, dashboards, and monitoring and accountability mechanisms

## Skills

• Engaging leadership and the ability to exert positive strategic influence with a variety of stakeholders, with or without direct line authority

• Strong ability to coordinate, manage projects and change, and ensure strategic alignment

• Strong analytical, synthesis and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and formulate strategic recommendations

• Excellent communication, collaboration and negotiation skills, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly to diverse audiences, including decision-making bodies

• Ability to quickly become familiar with ongoing files and projects, structure their progress and mobilize the parties involved toward achieving results

• Ability to manage multiple files simultaneously, set priorities and work effectively in contexts of ambiguity, change or limited resources

• Ability to support managers and teams through organizational transformation and evolving practices

• Initiative, rigour, judgment, autonomy and results orientation

## General requirements

• Adherence to organizational values and demonstration of a professional attitude aligned with the interests of the City of Dieppe and the community

• Compliance with confidentiality and information management rules and policies

• Demonstrate punctuality and regular attendance

• Ability to perform the duties inherent to the position (physical requirements, where applicable)

• Ability to maintain satisfactory job performance

## WORK SCHEDULE

• Thirty-five (35) hours per week

• Work outside regular office hours, including evenings and weekends, as required

## COMPENSATION

• In accordance with the salary scale in effect for non-unionized employees

• The incumbent also receives vacation, employer-paid benefits and a pension plan (employer/employee contributions).

## CLOSING DATE

• The deadline to submit an application is October 13th, 2026 at 23:59.

Disclaimer: The statements above describe the principal characteristics of the position and are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. They should not be considered an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, abilities and occupational requirements inherent in the position.

Note: The municipality officially declared itself a francophone city offering bilingual services in 2000 (Municipal Administration Language Policy A-9). As French is the language of work, all employees must be able to communicate orally and in writing in both French and English.

title: Benefits Services Specialist

title: Maintenance Repairperson B - Competition Number: 2026/27-017-910850P
description:
## About NLHC

The Newfoundland and Labrador Housing Corporation (NL Housing) is a crown corporation whose mandate is to develop and administer housing assistance policy and programs for the benefit of low to moderate income households throughout the province. As the largest landlord in the Province, NL Housing manages a portfolio of over 5,500 units province-wide. The services provided by NL Housing provide clients with access to safe, stable and affordable housing, which is essential to the social, financial, and physical well-being of individuals, families and communities. There is a wide range of housing needs across the province, from those facing homelessness or at risk of homelessness, to low income households needing assistance to pay rent or complete much-needed repairs on their homes. For more information on our programs and services, and strategic priorities, please visit our website www.nlhc.nl.ca.

## About the Department/Region

Context:

The Labrador Region maintains and supports approximately 250 NL Housing rental properties in the areas served by an office in Goose Bay and a sub-office in Labrador City. The region provides a wide range of services, including receiving and processing rental applications; administering rental accounts and lease compliance provisions; providing various client services and tenant relations including eviction prevention, and monitoring, facilitating and administering property maintenance. A variety of programs designed to support low to moderate income households and homeowners are also delivered. Regional staff members are involved in the delivery of the Provincial Home Repair, Home Modification, Home Energy Savings, Partner Managed Housing, and Rent Supplement Programs.

## Position Details

Competition Number:2026/27-017-910850P

Employment Type: 1 Permanent Position

Department/Region: Labrador

Location: Labrador City

Posting Status: External

Closing Date: October 11, 2026

Salary Scale: $52,062 to $57,616 per annum (CG-26, $25.03 to $27.70per hour), 40 hour work week

Allowances:Labrador Allowance: with dependent $8,939, without $4,529

Travel Allowance: $1,425 for employee and $1,053 per dependent

Duties:

The incumbent performs skilled repair, maintenance, and refurbishment work on NL Housing residential units, including preparing vacant units for occupancy. Duties include plastering, painting, drywall repair, and general carpentry such as repairing and replacing doors, windows, flooring, siding, and cabinetry, as well as minor construction work. The role also involves basic plumbing repairs, including installing and repairing fixtures, clearing blockages, and identifying leaks. Work may include mold and mildew remediation and minor asbestos abatement in accordance with safety standards.

Additional responsibilities include completing minor electrical-related tasks, ensuring safety systems are operational, and performing interior and exterior repairs using appropriate tools and equipment. The incumbent estimates materials and labour, maintains records, and communicates professionally with tenants while working in occupied units. Other related duties, including seasonal tasks, may be required.

## Screening Criteria

Completion of a Carpentry, Painting and Decorating, or Renovation Technician program (equivalencies may be considered).

Experience in residential plastering and painting.

Experience in residential carpentry, maintenance, or construction.

Experience in basic plumbing.

Journeyperson Certificate of Qualification in Carpentry or Painting & Decorating (Asset)

## Assessment Criteria

Knowledge of plastering and painting practices, including the use and care of tools.

Knowledge of carpentry methods and practices, including the use and care of tools.

Knowledge of basic plumbing practices, including the use and care of tools.

Knowledge of the National Building Code is considered an asset.

Ability to estimate materials, supplies, and labour.

Ability to effectively exchange information.

Ability to work independently and manage time and tasks efficiently.

Client Service Orientation

## Conditions of Employment

Conditions of Offer:

1. Proof of a valid class 5 driver's license.

2. An acceptable Certificate of Conduct

Conditions of Acceptance:

1. Willing to accept day travel (significant)

2. Willing to accept overnight travel to remote areas (periodic)

3. Acknowledgement of requirement for heavy lifting (greater than 50 lbs)

## Applicant Information

This is a CUPE Local 1860 bargaining unit position and as per the Collective Agreement, applicants internal to the bargaining unit will be processed prior to other candidates.

Newfoundland Labrador Housing values diversity in the workforce and is an equal opportunity employer.

Disability related accommodations are available upon request at any stage of the recruitment process by contacting recruitmentaccommodations@nlhc.nl.ca or by calling (709) 724-3002.

Preference will be given to applicants who are legally entitled to work in Canada.

Applications should be received prior to midnight Newfoundland Standard time on the closing day.

The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application submitted clearly demonstrates the required criteria. Applications that do not clearly demonstrate the required screening criteria will be screened out.

The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application includes accurate and current contact information, including phone number, mailing and e-mail addresses.

All information submitted as part of this application must be factual, complete and current to date of submission. Successful applicants will be required to provide proof of stated credentials as part of the selection process.

This competition may be used to fill future similar vacancies with NL Housing.

Please note that applications will not be accepted in-person, by fax, email or mail at this time.

NL Health Services, Urban Zone offers the full continuum of health and community services including public health, long-term care, community services, hospital care and unique provincial programs and services. NL Health Services prides ourselves on providing the highest quality care and service possible to the people in our communities, in our region, and in the province. The Mental Health and Addictions Program of NL Health Services (NLHS) – Eastern Urban Zone is seeking a 0.5 FTE salaried General/Family Physician to provide medical support to individuals engaged in the Eating Disorder Continuum (EDC) of services. The EDC includes both inpatient and outpatient components and offers specialized care to individuals (ages 18 years and older) experiencing eating disorders.

We are a provincial health authority responsible for delivering quality health care to approximately 550,000 people in Newfoundland and Labrador. Supported by over 23,000 employees and physicians, our team works together to improve the health and well-being of every person, in every community. Guided by the vision of the Health Accord NL, we offer a range of health-care programs and services through a wide network of facilities, clinics, and community services across five zones: Central, Eastern-Rural, Eastern-Urban, Labrador-Grenfell, and Western.

At NL Health Services, we believe that our people — employees, doctors and volunteers — make it a great place to work. Every individual brings valuable knowledge, experience and perspective. It is in this diversity that we find strength. We are committed to embracing the distinct and complementary characteristics of our members, as we seek to eliminate health disparities, and ensuring we provide fair, equitable and quality health care to everyone.

If you are passionate about making a difference and providing exceptional health care, we want to hear from you. Join our team and be part of something extraordinary.

## ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

The Medical Imaging Program of NL Health Services – Eastern Urban Zone is seeking an Interventional Radiologist with interest in vascular work, available to start immediately.

The group practice is affiliated with the Faculty of Medicine at Memorial University of Newfoundland and Labrador and its Radiology Residency training program, providing opportunities for research and teaching.

The group offers a busy service in CT, MRI, Ultrasound, Fluoroscopy, and General X-ray, with a full scope of vascular and non-vascular interventional procedures including supporting a busy Cancer Clinic. description:
COMPETITION NUMBER PC25018
CLASSIFICATION NAME Registered Nurse Class D
POSITION TITLE Nurse Practitioner - NB Health Link (NBHL)
CLASSIFICATION CODE RNCD
BARGAINING UNIT NBNU
UNIT LOCATION Fredericton
STATUS Full Time Permanent
FULL TIME EQUIVALENT 1.0
HOURS OF WORK Starting 0800hr to 1600hr Monday-Friday. Subject to change due to operational requirements.
ANTICIPATED START DATE As soon as possible
ANTICIPATED END DATE SALARY RANGE

As per collective agreement
LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT Written and spoken competence in English and French is required.
CLOSING DATE Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

NB Health Link (NBHL) leverages technological solutions and innovative clinical delivery models to provide access to care for New Brunswickers who don't have a family doctor or nurse practitioner. The program provides patients who are registered with the program access to a network of family doctors and nurse practitioners throughout the province - offering in-person, telephone and online appointments in both official languages.

As part of NBHL, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

## JOB SUMMARY

The Nurse Practitioner (NP) is a generalist who offers quality and relevant care across the health continuum and throughout the patient's lifespan, including health promotion, disease and injury, prevention, curative, supportive, rehabilitative, and palliative care within an interdisciplinary team of health providers.

The service model is based on the principles of primary health care with the goal of supporting communities in meeting their health care needs.

As a key member of the NB Health Link team, the NP is responsible and accountable for their practice and professional conduct while working in collaboration with physicians to ensure quality and relevant care.

As an EM/ANB employee, the NPs are accountable to our patients and families and co-workers by participating in and supporting safety related initiatives as well as acting in a manner that fosters a culture of learning. Safety for patients, caregivers, and workplace are kept the priority.

## ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Integrates a broad knowledge base and critical appraisal in determining and communicating the diagnosis and the patient's needs.

• Applies advanced assessment techniques, critical thinking and clinical decision-making skills when assessing patients.

• Systematically collects documents and critically analyzes health data by performing a holistic health assessment using multiple tools and sources of data.

• Completes a prescription accurately and completely according to relevant legislation, standards, and policies.

• Orders diagnostic imaging tests, laboratory and other tests when clinically indicated and in accordance with the Nurse Practitioner Schedules and program guidelines for Ordering.

• Promotes health and reduces the risk of complications, illness, and injury for patients.

• Ensures that diagnostic tests are interpreted, and results are acted upon in an appropriate and timely manner.

• Monitor the ongoing therapy of patients with chronic stable illnesses.

• Screen for the presence of chronic illnesses and works in collaboration with physicians who identified presence of chronic illness in patients.

• Monitors the effectiveness of interventions.

• Facilitates the patient's transition within and between health care settings, e.g., admitting,

• transferring, and discharging patients.

• Ability to work independently and as part of the interdisciplinary team including making appropriate referrals.

• Documents clinical data, assessment findings, diagnosis, plan of care, therapeutic intervention (including consent), patients' response and clinical rationale in a timely and accurate manner in the patient health record.

• Maintain a positive working relationship with the interdisciplinary team.

• Help build protocols and templates in prevention medicine for the program.

• Responsibilities to support the core provincial program will be the primary task.

• Other responsibilities may be assigned to support the program.

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor's Degree in Nursing and successful completion of a postgraduate Nurse Practitioner program in Primary Health Care.

• Registered as a Nurse Practitioner with the Nurses Association of New Brunswick

• Current Basic Life Saving certificate and maintain certification.

• A least 2 years' experience in primary health care setting in Community Health Centre or Collaborative Practice.;

• Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills;

• Demonstrated organizational and leadership skills;

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with other members of a team toward common goals;

• Demonstrated ability to function independently in the role with recognized decision-making and problem-solving skills;

• Demonstrated ability to critically analyze theory and research literature and apply to practice;

• Demonstrated ability to integrate a determinants of health approach into care delivery;

• Actively participates as a team member to provide comprehensive care to all patients;

• Must be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record;

• Adherence to professional ethical principles.

• Skillful use of computer tools and Microsoft Office Programs.

All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

NBHL is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

title: Accounting Project Manager
description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

## The Role

We are hiring an Accounting Project Manager to join our team of dedicated accounting professionals. In this role, you will support multiple Cooke projects, ensuring that accounting requirements are met and that the project teams are supported.

This position offers the perfect blend of core accounting knowledge and hands-on project experience on a global scale, including system implementations and process improvement initiatives. You'll have the opportunity to work with international teams and gain insight into how accounting and systems operate across different regions.

This role can be based in either our Saint John, NB or Blacks Harbour, NB office.

## Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

description:
## Travel Consultant - Customer Service Representative

On Site Training | Work From Home Opportunities | Starting at $21/hour + bonus potential

## Helping People Through the Moments That Matter

Travel doesn't always go according to plan.

Flights get cancelled. Weather disrupts plans. Connections are missed. Things don't always go as expected.

When that happens, our customers need more than someone to answer the call. They need someone who can listen, understand what matters most, and confidently guide them towards a solution.

As a Travel Consultant, you'll help our customers book, manage and modify their travel arrangements while delivering the exceptional service they expect. Whether you're helping a customer rebook a flight, adjust hotel reservations, navigate a travel disruption, or maximize the benefits available to them, you'll play an important role in turning stressful situations into positive experiences.

This isn't just about booking travel. It's about building trust, solving problems, and making customers feel genuinely supported when they need it most.

If you're someone who loves helping people, communicates naturally, and can stay focused when things get busy, we'd love to meet you!

## Why You'll Love Working Here

At Cloud5, we believe great customer experiences start with great people.

We'll provide the training, coaching, and support you need to succeed, even if you've never worked in travel before. You'll develop valuable customer service, communication, consulting, and problem-solving skills while working alongside a team that genuinely supports one another.

No two days are exactly the same. You'll tackle new challenges, connect with different customers, and continuously build skills that will benefit you throughout your career.

## No travel experience? No problem!

If you have strong customer service skills, enjoy helping people, and are passionate about creating positive customer experiences, we'll provide the training to help you succeed.

## Why Join Us?

• $21/hour starting wage with quarterly bonus potential

• Shift premiums across various hours/days

• Work from home opportunities following successful completion of training

• Employee referral bonus of up to $500 per successful candidate

• Medical & Vision benefits after 3 months

• Dental coverage after 6 months

• RRSP and TFSA options

• Company RRSP match up to 3 percent after 1 year

• Paid training and ongoing coaching to help you succeed

• Career growth opportunities within a growing organization

• Access to various travel perks and discounts

## What You'll Do

• Help customers book, manage, modify and troubleshoot travel arrangements

• Resolve travel-related issues and provide solutions during disruptions and unexpected situations

• Communicate with customers by phone to understand their needs and provide personalized support

• Demonstrate the value and benefits available to the customer

• Consult with customers to identify the best available options based on their unique circumstances

• Coordinate with travel suppliers and partners to secure travel arrangements and resolve issues

• Research solutions, troubleshoot challenges, and think creatively when standard options aren't available

• Maintain a calm, professional, and empathetic approach during complex or high-pressure situations

• Deliver a consistently exceptional customer experience while meeting service expectations

## What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Success in this role isn't measured by how much you know about travel on day one. It's measured by how well you listen, solve problems, and create positive experiences for customers.

## You may be a great fit if you:

• Connect naturally with people and build rapport easily

• Are an active listener who takes the time to understand customer needs

• Lead conversations with empathy, professionalism, and confidence

• Enjoy troubleshooting and finding solutions to complex problems

• Can balance customer needs with program guidelines and available options

• Stay calm and resourceful when handling challenging situations

• Are highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks at once

• Communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing

• Are comfortable using technology and navigating multiple systems simultaneously

• Have a positive attitude, growth mindset and genuine desire to help others

Experience in customer service, hospitality, travel, contact center, or other service-focused environments is considered an asset, but we are equally interested in candidates who demonstrate strong communication skills, curiosity, and a customer first mindset.

As Atlantic Canada's largest regional law firm, Stewart McKelvey is committed to delivering exceptional legal services and innovative solutions to clients across Canada and beyond. With six offices and a growing national reach, the firm continues to evolve its approach to business development, client service, and commercial operations to support long-term growth.

Think of this role less as closing deals and more as building the engine behind growth: you won't be pitching clients yourself, but you will be the person equipping the firm's lawyers with the strategy, tools, and structure they need to win and grow business. A solid grounding in business development and marketing principles is essential, but it will be applied through strategy, systems, and enablement rather than direct client-facing sales.

Reporting to the Director, Commercial Operations, this role will serve as a key partner to firm leadership, supporting business development strategy execution, pricing initiatives, proposal management, CRM optimization, and commercial operations across the firm. This is an exciting opportunity for a collaborative professional who enjoys bringing structure to complex initiatives, leading through change, and helping professionals achieve growth objectives.

## The Opportunity

As Manager, Business Development & Pricing, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the firm's strategic growth initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor to lawyers, practice groups, and internal stakeholders, you will help translate strategy into action by driving business development programs, managing pricing workflows, supporting proposal development, and contributing to a high-performing team. This role is highly collaborative in nature and requires an individual who can move comfortably between practice areas, communicate clearly, anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and provide thoughtful solutions in a fast-paced professional services environment. You will provide leadership to a team of professionals while working closely with departments across the firm's offices.

## Key Responsibilities:

• Support the implementation of firm-wide business development strategies and growth initiatives.

• Partner with lawyers and practice groups to enhance client development activities and identify opportunities for growth.

• Coordinate and manage pricing activities, including annual rate reviews, client pricing arrangements, alternative fee arrangements (AFAs), and RFP pricing submissions.

• Collaborate with Finance and firm leadership to develop pricing recommendations and support informed decision-making.

• Lead and support proposal and RFP development, ensuring high-quality submissions that align with client objectives.

• Oversee the firm's CRM strategy and adoption efforts, leveraging data to support business development planning and decision-making.

• Drive process improvements and operational efficiencies across business development and pricing functions.

• Support change management initiatives related to emerging technologies, evolving client expectations, and business development best practices.

• Prepare reports, presentations, and recommendations for senior leadership and internal stakeholders.

• Serve as a key resource for lawyers and internal clients, responding to requests with professionalism, urgency, and sound judgment.

• Coach, mentor, and develop team members while fostering a collaborative and service-focused culture.

## The Ideal Candidate

You are a planner and implementer who enjoys bringing people, processes, and priorities together. You are service-oriented, highly organized, and naturally collaborative, with the ability to build credibility and influence across diverse stakeholder groups. You thrive in environments where responsiveness, professionalism, and quality matter. You are comfortable leading teams through change, and balancing strategic objectives with day-to-day operational demands.

Most importantly, you are someone who anticipates needs, approaches challenges with solutions, and can be relied upon to deliver results.

## Qualifications

• Post-secondary education in Business, Marketing, Commerce, Communications, Finance, or a related discipline.

• Experience in business development, commercial operations, client service, project management, pricing, account management, marketing, or a related function.

• Experience working within a professional services environment is considered a strong asset.

• Previous people leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, or managing direct reports.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• Excellent written communication and proposal-writing abilities.

• Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Strong business acumen and comfort working with financial and operational information.

• Experience implementing CRM or similar systems would be considered an asset.

• Proven ability to lead teams through organizational change and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.

## Why Join Stewart McKelvey?

This is an opportunity to join one of Atlantic Canada's most respected professional services organizations at a time of significant growth and evolution. You will have the opportunity to lead firm-wide business development and pricing initiatives while working alongside a collaborative leadership team committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and exceptional client service.

Stewart McKelvey offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• RRSP or pension matching program

• Professional development opportunities

• Collaborative and supportive team environment

• Flexible approach to in-office work across the firm's office network

If you are a commercially minded leader who enjoys bringing strategy to life, supporting teams through change, and helping professionals achieve meaningful growth, we would welcome the opportunity to connect with you.

If you have any questions, please contact Kate Spares, Recruitment Specialist, at kspares@kbrs.ca or Jeff Lanthier, Partner, at jlanthier@kbrs.ca. If you require accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
## Medical Science Liaison

Sequence Bio is a Newfoundland and Labrador-based biotechnology company conducting genetic research to discover the true biological causes of disease.

We collaborate with the people and medical professionals of Newfoundland and Labrador, and partner with leading pharma and biotech to help accelerate the development of better medicines for global unmet medical needs.

## The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated Medical Science Liaison to join our team. As the Medical Science Liaison, you'll represent a peer-to-peer scientific bridge between Sequence Bio's Chief Scientific Officer / Principal Investigator and our research collaborators.

We're looking for someone who can translate complex genomic research into trusted, actionable partnerships within the Newfoundland and Labrador healthcare community. In this role, you'll build strong relationships with regional physicians and specialists, accelerate research study enrollment, and share the impact of our findings with a wide range of stakeholders. If you're driven to make a lasting, real-world difference, this is your chance to be part of something that can truly matter for patients and their families for generations to come.

The Role
What You'll Do
Responsibilities
Research & Healthcare Provider Collaboration

• Serve as the primary scientific point of contact for healthcare and research collaborators, positioning Sequence Bio as a true innovation and research partner within the provincial healthcare system.

• Build and maintain trusted, collaborative partnerships with regional specialists, general practitioners, clinical researchers and other healthcare providers within target disease areas (e.g., respirology, rheumatology, oncology).

• Collaboratively develop streamlined referral and outreach processes with research partners to optimize participant identification and accelerate enrollment across active research studies.

## Scientific Communication & Education

• Deliver compelling, objective presentations on the scientific value of Newfoundland and Labrador's founder population, genetic architecture, and the mechanics of family-based validation studies.

• Provide scientific education to clinicians on target disease cohorts (e.g., MASH, Ankylosing Spondylitis, Multiple Sclerosis) and collaborate on inclusion/exclusion criteria considerations to support study enrollment.

• Represent Sequence Bio at regional medical conferences, symposia, and working groups to engage new partners and communicate progress, abstract data, and research milestone achievements.

• Synthesize clinical insights from community healthcare providers and collaborate with internal science and research teams to align study goals with provincial healthcare infrastructure.

Who You Are
Qualifications & Skills

• Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Biological or Life Sciences, Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Healthcare and Clinical Professionals, (advanced degree like an MSc, PhD, or PharmD is an asset). A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in healthcare stakeholder engagement, research partnerships, medical affairs, or professional biotech/pharmaceutical relations.

• Regional Network: Established professional relationships within the Newfoundland and Labrador healthcare ecosystem (e.g., NL Health Services, private specialty).

• Mobility & Residency: Current residency in Newfoundland and Labrador is required, along with the ability to travel across the province's health zones as needed.

• Scientific Acumen: Strong functional understanding of genetics, human biology, and population health concepts; demonstrated ability to confidently discuss complex scientific data and research methodologies with medical specialists (e.g., Rheumatologists, Oncologists, Neurologists).

• Communication & Presentation Mastery: Advanced public speaking and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex genomic research objectives into clear, engaging narratives. Comfortable presenting to diverse audiences, ranging from formal clinical panels and academic symposia to community-facing patient advocacy groups.

• Advocacy & Community Engagement: Proven track record of building trusted, collaborative partnerships with non-profit health foundations and patient advocacy groups.

• Growth Mindset & Curiosity: A proactive learner with a strong intellectual curiosity and eagerness to continually expand their knowledge of genomics, data-driven drug discovery, and emerging precision medicine trends as the company grows.

## Why Join Sequence Bio

Working with us means working for the benefit of others. Whether your job is analyzing multi-dimensional data sets or coding a research application-we're all driven by the same purpose: enable breakthrough medical discoveries to improve lives around the world.

Our Benefits
Our benefits include:

• Fair and equitable salary

• Competitive stock option plan

• Progressive health and wellness plan

• Company-matched retirement savings

• Generous PTO and parental and family leave

• Learning and professional development allowance

## Our Commitment

Ethics, privacy and security excellence is rooted in everything we do at Sequence Bio. We are transparent about our information sharing policies and practices, and are committed to returning benefits to Newfoundland and Labrador. All our employees must uphold the company's commitment in all they do and champion the company's ethics, privacy and security mindset to ensure we maintain our best-in-class approach.

Sequence Bio is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB), and recognize the importance and value of a diverse workforce. We are committed to creating a safe, inclusive and respectful environment for everyone we interact with. If you could benefit from an accommodation during any stage of our recruitment process, please share with us how we can best support you.

## Culture and Recognition

Sequence Bio has been named one of Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers for 2026. This recognition highlights our commitment to our team through supportive policies, comprehensive benefits, continuous professional development, our leadership in gender diversity, and more.

Sequence Bio is also recognized as one of Atlantic Canada's Best Places to Work for 2026 by Atlantic Business Magazine. From our inclusive culture and competitive benefits to our commitment to professional growth and employee well-being, this award highlights our commitment to putting our people first.

title: Underground Mine Trainer
description:
Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is transforming the future?

## Who We Are

We are Vale Base Metals – a global supplier of the critical minerals transforming the future.

With industry-leading reserves of copper and nickel in Canada, Brazil, and Indonesia, and state-of-the-art infrastructure in the U.K., Canada, and Japan, VBM delivers a secure and responsible supply of high-quality products to customers across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Global demand for critical minerals is growing exponentially. From energy to aerospace, batteries to magnets, robotics to artificial intelligence, a secure and responsible supply of critical minerals is fundamental to power modern technologies. And at Vale Base Metals, we are transforming our business to provide a secure and responsible supply of these minerals.

Join our diverse team of 13,000 talented individuals committed to providing mineral security to a world in transition. We invite you to put your skills to work, driving meaningful and enduring change while enjoying a rewarding career.

## The Opportunity

We are currently seeking Underground Mine Trainers to join our People & Community Department in Voisey's Bay, Labrador, a fly-in fly-out operation. Relocation will be required for this role.

This permanent position will be on a 2 week on/2 week off rotation working at the mine site.

As an Underground Mine Trainer, your primary responsibility will be to ensure that employees receive the knowledge and practical training to work safely and productively in an Underground Mine environment. You will also support the development of workers in other related fields as per business need. Your experience and skills will allow you to administer and assist in the development, coordinator, and delivery of all facets of Underground Miner training. You will be required to perform regulatory training, equipment training, assess competencies/qualifications, and execute Vale related training initiatives.

Additionally, in this position you will:

• Provide instruction and functional training on mining equipment and processes to a level of competency required by the company.

• Organize and deliver safe and effective classroom, practical and follow-up training in a timely manner.

• Develop Equipment, OHS, Site and Company related training programs.

• Mentor and coach employees in the safe, effective and productive operation of Underground work.

• Deliver orientation training to all employees, contractors, and visitors to site as scheduled.

• Deliver specialized certification training to the entire site as required. (examples include Fall Protection, LOTO and First Aid).

• Develop, coordinate and provide field instruction and competency evaluations to support applicable maintenance and other training programs.

## What We Offer You

• Competitive compensation including a variable annual incentive plan

• Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

• Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, flex health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans and optional insurances)

• Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, personal, sick, parental)

• Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Virtual Healthcare online

• Online training and career development opportunities

• Relocation Assistance

• Chartered flights within Newfoundland & Labrador

• 24/7 access to a fully stocked cafeteria with balanced meals prepared by our culinary team

• Access to recreational facilities and social activities (cardio/weight room, gymnasium, music room, movie theatre, etc.)

• Accommodations are equipped with cable TV, internet, and unlimited long-distance calling

• All Personal Protective Equipment is provided upon hire. Employees are given a safety boot allowance and receive a 100% reimbursement for prescription safety glasses

## About You

## Education:

• A minimum of Secondary School or equivalent is required.

• Completion of a program of study related to adult education and administration of workplace learning and training is preferred.

• Underground Hard Rock Miner Common Core with Specialty Modules or equivalent (Please provide transcript with application).

• Additional Trainer Certifications (Workplace NL Trainer, St John Ambulance Trainer, etc.) are considered an asset.

• Minimum Class 5 provincial Driver License.

## Experience:

• A minimum of 8 years' underground mining experience with a proven ability to operate a variety of underground equipment and processes across production and development as well as construction aspects of mining (Scoop Tram, Haulage Truck, Mechanized Rock Bolter, Jumbo, In-The-Hole drill (ITH), Scaler, Scissor Deck, UG Construction, muck circuit- crusher/conveyor, boom truck, forklift, pastefill etc.) is required. A combination of operating and maintenance experience with underground equipment will also be considered.

• Experience with Maclean, CAT, Sandvik and Epiroc equipment preferred.

• Experience with Mining Equipment Simulator Operation preferred. Experience with computer- or console- based video games may be considered as transferable skills.

• Experience working with a Learning Management System preferred.

• Underground Mine Rescue experience is considered an asset.

## Skills:

• Ability to promote and demonstrate Risk Management and Health & Safety in training.

• Strong communication and presentation skills – both oral and written.

• Solid working knowledge of NL OH&S and Mines Safety Acts and Regulations.

• Experience working in a diverse culture and the ability to facilitate effectively.

• Self-motivated, and be an active team member to ensure team goals are achieved.

• Proficient use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.).

## Why Newfoundland and Labrador

Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada's easternmost province, is known for its rugged coastline, rich cultural heritage, and significant natural resources. The province's economy is bolstered by a robust mining sector, where Vale Base Metals' integrated operations play a crucial role.

At Long Harbour, we operate a state-of-the-art processing plant, which refines nickel concentrate from Vale Base Metals' Voisey's Bay mine, located in Labrador, into nickel, copper, and cobalt products. This plant is a cornerstone of our commitment to value-added processing in Canada. Meanwhile, the Voisey's Bay mine is one of the world's most substantial nickel deposits. It provides high-quality nickel, copper, and cobalt, essential for the 21st century economy.

## Include to Transform

At Vale Base Metals, we are committed to ensuring an inclusive work environment where people can act like owners, being their authentic selves and empowering them to deliver results. Vale Base Metals encourages everyone to express their ideas and opinions and values the plurality of individual profiles. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are critical to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or any other personal consideration that makes us different.

Vale is an equal opportunity employer seeking to increase diversity across our operations and improve equal opportunity at Vale and in the mining industry.

Vale recognizes the Impacts and Benefits Agreements with the Innu Nation and the Nunatsiavut Government in which Innu and Inuit workers have first preference for employment at the Voisey's Bay Mine Site. This is guided by an adjacency principle that first gives preference to those who live on the coast of Labrador, followed by those residing in the rest of Labrador, those residing on the island of the province, followed by the rest of Canada.

Next, priority will be given to Newfoundland and Labrador residents. We also welcome those who are willing to relocate back home and those looking to make NL their permanent home.

Accommodation is available throughout our recruitment process for applicants with disabilities.

Innu Nation members and Nunatsiavut beneficiaries can submit their application to their Vale Indigenous Employment Coordinator.

Employees engaged by the Company must be lawfully able to work for the Company in the country where the role is located. The Company does not provide immigration, work permit, or permanent residence sponsorship or assistance.

Pay Grade: G01

Apply by: Sunday, October 4th, 2026

title: Senior Lead, IHL legal Advisor (Training, Education and Outreach)
description:
Title: Senior Lead, IHL legal Advisor (Training, Education and Outreach)

Employee Working Location: Partially Virtual / Hybrid (Canada)

Employment Status: Permanent Full-time

The Canadian Red Cross (CRC) is an inspirational not-for-profit organization that helps people and communities in Canada and around the world in times of need and supports them in strengthening their resilience. As one of Canada's Best Employers 2026, we are committed to creating an accessible, diverse, inclusive, and barrier-free work environment.

The Senior Lead, International Humanitarian Law (IHL) Advisor (Training, Education and Outreach) provides strategic leadership and expert legal guidance to advance the understanding, promotion, and application of International Humanitarian Law in Canada and, where appropriate, internationally. This role leads the development of IHL education, training, and outreach initiatives, builds and maintains key education and training partnerships, and ensures the accuracy and quality of all IHL-related content and education programming. Through this work, the position supports the Canadian Red Cross's humanitarian mission.

## In this role you will:

• Lead the planning, coordination, and implementation of IHL education and dissemination activities across Canada and, where applicable, internationally, in furtherance of CRC's IHL strategy and operational plan.

• Oversee the development and ensure quality of IHL training content, tools, and dissemination materials at national, provincial, and international levels to ensure legal accuracy, coherency and consistency of materials.

• Serve as a spokesperson for IHL education, training and outreach and other topics as requested, collaborating with across departments to represent CRC at key relevant forums and events.

• Supervise the work planning and execution of work plans on all IHL education, training and outreach deliverables ensuring alignment with the CRC's strategic goals and the fulfilment of the CRC IHL unit's training, education and outreach commitments ensuring quality coherence and consistency.

• Lead and maintain engagement with relevant stakeholders such as military and police institutions, security institutes, academic partners including education and dissemination partners to strengthen IHL training and education.

• Lead specific IHL education-related projects, ensuring timely and effective execution.

• Identify and lead new business and funding opportunities for IHL education, training and outreach in collaboration with Philanthropy and other teams.

• In conjunction with Senior Legal Advisor, IHL, apply an IHL legal lens to CRC's work as a National Society and in particular in compliance with the Fundamental Principles and the CRC's mandate to disseminate IHL and work with the Government of Canada to ensure respect of IHL.

## What we are looking for:

title: Account Manager – Accounting Professional
description:
## Full Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced accounting professional to join Marsh's Captive Operations Group. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of captive insurance companies and oversee their day?to?day operations, including financial reporting, treasury, insurance administration, and corporate/regulatory compliance. You will deliver high?quality service to clients, support audit and regulatory processes, and contribute to continuous improvement of our procedures.

Preference will be given to those candidates based in Nova Scotia. If you are located in the Halifax Regional Municipality, this will be a hybrid role requiring at least three days per week in the office.

## We will count on you to:

• Prepare accurate and timely financial statements and any client?required supplemental schedules.

• Reconcile cash and investment accounts and execute payments as required.

• Prepare and file regulatory and tax filings on a quarterly and/or annual basis as required.

• Coordinate client audits end?to?end, including planning, scheduling, testing coordination, and issuance of final deliverables often managing multiple audits concurrently.

• Plan and organize client meetings, including Shareholders' Meetings and Annual General Meetings; prepare materials, participate and present, as appropriate, based on client needs.

• Provide proactive, responsive support for clients' day?to?day requests and operational needs.

• Maintain client files and correspondence to established standards and best practices to help identify risks and opportunities.

• Build and sustain strong client relationships, promptly identifying and resolving issues.

• Liaise with external service providers and other stakeholders on behalf of clients.

• Coach, mentor, and support junior team members and new colleagues.

• Adhere to Marsh internal controls and client?specific control requirements.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of standardized procedures to improve efficiency and consistency.

• Develop and maintain a strong working knowledge of insurance, insurance policies and insurance accounting.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

## What you need to have:

• Qualified CPA, or a minimum of five years' equivalent experience focused on preparing financial statements and maintaining supporting working papers.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or equivalent.

• Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast?paced environment and meet tight deadlines.

• Strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize competing demands.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact effectively and confidently with stakeholders at all levels, both in person and virtually.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.

## What makes you stand out:

• Relevant experience in the captive insurance industry.

• 3+ years' experience working with or within an insurance company.

• Familiarity with Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP), Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as they relate to insurance entities.

• Familiarity with US regulatory requirements for insurance companies.

## Why join our team:

Competitive Pay - Marsh offers a thriving culture to bring your authentic self to work along with competitive employee benefits; base salary, overtime pay, annual bonus potential, a monthly Stock Savings Plan (with 2/3 matching) and a full benefits package starting from day one - medical, dental, vision, wellness and health spending account, short and long-term disability, life insurance, as well as retirement savings options (again with 2/3 matching).

Balance your Life - Generous paid time off for vacation, sick days, company holidays, floating holidays, hybrid work, and time to give back to your community; a flexible work culture and generous parental and maternity leave top-ups.

Reach Your Goals - Marsh offers financial and educational support towards your accounting designation.

Our Culture - A company with a strong brand and strong results to match, Marsh is committed to making a difference in the lives of people. A culture of belonging, innovation, collaboration, internal mobility, and extraordinary career opportunities.

Be an Owner - Participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan at a discounted share price.

Level Up - Employee Resource Groups provide access to leaders, relevant volunteer and mentoring opportunities, and interactions with colleagues in industry groups and client organizations.

Marsh Risk is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Marsh Risk, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one "anchor day" per week on which their full team will be together in person.

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be made on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for overtime and performance-based incentives.

We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition assistance, retirement programs as well as employee assistance programs.

title: Horizon Pediatric Endocrinologist
description:
## This is the life-changing opportunity you've been looking for.

## Horizon Health Network in beautiful New Brunswick is looking for a

## Pediatric Endocrinologist to join our team!

Horizon Health Network, Saint John area (Region 2), is actively seeking a full-time Pediatric Endocrinologist, either locum or permanent, to join our collaborative team in Saint John, New Brunswick. The Saint John Regional Hospital is New Brunswick's largest tertiary care hospital, and the Department of Pediatrics has an active inpatient and outpatient unit along with a Level-3 NICU. The successful candidate will join a team of eight general pediatricians, six sub-specialty pediatricians (in the areas of Neurology and Neonatology), two diabetes nurses, one endocrinology nurse, and a pediatric dietitian. As a full-time pediatric endocrinologist, you will provide general pediatric endocrine clinics as well as a multi-disciplinary type-1 diabetes clinic. This position also includes general pediatric ward and call coverage. There is opportunity for teaching and research through Memorial University and Dalhousie University academic affiliations.

## Why you should work here

Horizon Health Network (Horizon) is proud of its dedicated team of health care professionals who are focused on delivering safe and quality care to our patients, clients, families, and communities. Horizon is a great place to work, as people are the heart of our organization, and the success of Horizon is a direct result of our employees' dedication, professionalism, and commitment.

Horizon is the largest regional health authority – and one of the largest employers – in New Brunswick, and the second-largest health authority in Atlantic Canada. Our leadership and health care providers are experts in diverse areas of health and community services and provide services to a half a million people.

Horizon has an annual budget of approximately $1.2 billion and has more than 13,000 employees, 1,100 physicians and 1,300 volunteers, as well as 17 foundations, 12 auxiliaries and 8 alumnae organizations.

## What you will do

Reporting to the Pediatric Department Head and the Medical Director for the area, the Pediatric Endocrinologist collaborates with other Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, Registered, Nurses, and other Allied Medical Staff.

• Provide ambulatory care in a clinic setting.

• Provide inpatient care as required and requested by the Clinical Department Head.

• Practice in a collaborative fashion as a member of an interdisciplinary team and consult with members of other health professions as appropriate.

• Participates in departmental medical education initiatives.

• Provide on-call services during statutory holidays, evenings, and weekends as part of the on-call schedule for the Department.

• Participate in medical practice that is compatible with the Health Authority's mission, values, and strategic directions.

• These responsibilities are basic. Additional duties may be assigned from time to time as may be necessary to the operation of Horizon Health Network.

## Hours of Work

• Hours of work are normally provided between 0800hrs – 1600hrs Monday to Friday, unless otherwise agreed upon by the Service/Department Head.

• After-hours and weekend call coverage in coordination with members of the Department.

## Remuneration

• Salaried.

• This is a Salaried position. Remuneration is based on the New Brunswick Medical Pay Plan. The current rates range between $241,748 to a maximum of $293,904 annually (locums receive 10% of the base salary in lieu of benefits) based on qualifications and experience.

• On call remuneration is Fee-For-Service which is a direct compensation between the physician and Medicare New Brunswick.

## Qualifications

• Must have a Medical Degree from a recognized medical school and postgraduate studies (residency) in the field of Pediatric Medicine.

• Certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada.

• Candidates must be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick.

• Proficiency in English is required. Bilingual skills would be considered an asset.

• In accordance with immigration requirements, preference will be given to Canadian citizens and Permanent Residents of Canada.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal and team-building skills.

• Good attendance and work record.

• Physically able to perform assigned duties.

## Expected Start Date

• As soon as possible.

## Incentives

• Candidates may be eligible for a Provincial Recruitment Incentive with a Return of Service Agreement. (Locums not eligible.)

• Relocation reimbursement of up to $8,000.

## About the Facility

Horizon's Saint John Regional Hospital is the largest tertiary care hospital in New Brunswick and is the primary health care referral centre for this area and to all New Brunswickers for major trauma and cardiac care.

The New Brunswick Trauma Program, New Brunswick Heart Centre, and the New Brunswick Stem Cell Transplant Centre are located within the hospital, as are Radiation Oncology and Nephrology services. This site offers autologous stem cell therapy and a stem cell processing laboratory.

The Saint John Regional Hospital also serves as the centre for Dalhousie Medicine New Brunswick's distributed medical education program. The hospital services a catchment population of 170,000 people.

## About the Community

Imagine…

A playground in Atlantic Canada surrounded by fresh waterways on one side and the ocean on the other.

Connect…

With a community of Maritime and Acadian people whose rich friendly culture will include you.

Belong…

To a community where families are able to raise their children in a safe, close-knit environment with a reasonable cost of living.

The Saint John area offers you a broad range of affordable housing options, from heritage properties to executive homes within the city and in nearby Kennebecasis Valley. Saint John, a booming harbor city is Canada's oldest incorporated city (1785) and home to the country's oldest museum and farmers' market. For spouses and families, there are excellent employment and educational prospects. The nearby towns and villages, such as St. Stephen, Sussex, and Grand Manan, provide a diverse selection of recreational and sport activities that appeal to all age groups

## Interested? Apply Today!

To learn more, visit MyHorizonCareer.ca/physicians

## About Horizon's Recruitment Process

We thank all applicant who apply; however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted. All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Horizon's recruitment screening process may include language proficiency testing, clerical testing and/or behavioral assessment. If you are selected for testing, you will be contacted via the email address provided on your application. The official results will be shared with the candidate, Human Resources and the requesting manager electronically and language results will be placed on the personnel file for Horizon's hiring purposes.

## Diversity Statement

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.

title: Senior Specialist Talent Management
description:
Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is growing?

## Who We Are

We are a global mining company dedicated to safely delivering nickel, copper, cobalt, and platinum group metals essential for the world's energy transition.

Our mission is to improve lives and shape a better future together.

From utensils to cellphones to satellites, our operations simplify daily life and enhance connectivity. Our metals are integral to life-saving medical equipment and the electric vehicles driving the fight against climate change – our work truly matters.

Join our diverse team of 15,000 talented individuals committed to transforming critical minerals into prosperity and sustainable development in countries like Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, and Japan. We invite you to use your skills with us and contribute to something meaningful and enduring.

## The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Senior Specialist Talent Management, DEI, Culture & Engagement to join our People & Culture team in Toronto, Ontario. The role is in a hybrid work environment and requires in office presence 2-3 days a week.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Talent, DEI, Culture & Employee Engagement, the incumbent will play a key role in creating and advancing enterprise people initiatives across Talent Management, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI), Culture, and Employee Engagement. The position combines program execution, data analytics, stakeholder engagement, and project management to deliver impactful employee experiences and organizational outcomes.

In this role, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of talent and culture programs while leveraging workforce data, technology, and insights to inform decision-making and drive business results. You will collaborate closely with HR teams, business leaders, and cross-functional partners to ensure programs are aligned with organizational priorities and employee needs.

## Key Responsibilities

## Talent Management

• Coordinate end-to-end talent processes, including performance management cycles, talent reviews, calibration sessions, and succession planning activities.

• Prepare talent review materials, dashboards, meeting documentation, and action plans to support leadership decision-making.

• Maintain talent and succession planning data, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality.

• Support asset teams in aligning talent initiatives with business objectives and workforce needs.

• Monitor key talent metrics and provide insights that support organizational effectiveness and workforce planning.

## Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)

• Support the execution of enterprise-wide DEI strategies and programs across the organization.

• Coordinate employee self-identification campaigns and DEI-related communications initiatives.

• Prepare and analyze DEI-related metrics and reporting for ESG and other organizational disclosures.

## Culture & Employee Experience

• Help translate organizational values into practical tools, resources, learning materials, and employee programs.

• Support culture-building initiatives, leadership roadshows, employee events, and engagement activities.

• Partner with Talent Acquisition and Corporate Communications teams to maintain employer branding assets and employee value proposition materials.

• Contribute to initiatives that strengthen employee connection, inclusion, and organizational culture.

## Employee Engagement

• Support the administration and execution of employee engagement surveys and pulse assessments.

• Analyze engagement data and develop reports, dashboards, heat maps, presentations, and recommendations.

• Coordinate employee recognition programs, reporting, and related communications.

## People Analytics, Reporting & Systems

• Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and workforce insights that support strategic decision-making.

• Partner with HR Reporting teams to produce standard and ad hoc reports using HRIS and survey platforms.

• Ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of talent, engagement, and DEI data.

• Collaborate with HRIS and IT teams to troubleshoot system issues, validate fixes, and improve reporting capabilities.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve efficiencies through automation, AI tools, and process enhancements.

## Project Management & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and manage project plans for talent, culture, DEI, and engagement initiatives, as required

• Develop presentations, facilitator guides, FAQs, communication materials, templates, and toolkits for key stakeholders.

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, timelines, deliverables, and governance requirements.

• Track budgets, vendor invoices, and project expenditures against approved plans.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance program effectiveness, scalability, and employee impact.

## About You

## Experience

• Minimum 5 to 7 years of progressive experience in Talent Management, Organizational Development, Human Resources, People Analytics, or a related Centre of Excellence environment.

• Hands-on experience supporting performance management, talent review, and succession planning processes.

• Experience working within complex, matrixed, and geographically dispersed organizations.

• Demonstrated experience supporting employee engagement, culture, and DEI initiatives.

• Proven track record of leveraging technology, automation, AI, or digital tools to improve processes and operational effectiveness.

• Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and sensitive information.

## Education

• Undergraduate Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Organizational Development, Analytics, or a related discipline.

• CHRP, CPHR, or equivalent professional designation (completed or in progress) is considered an asset.

• Experience with talent assessments and leadership development tools is considered an asset.

## Skills & Competencies

• Strong knowledge of talent management practices, including performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, and leadership development.

• Advanced analytical capabilities with experience working with workforce data, dashboards, and reporting tools.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUPs, and data analysis techniques.

• Experience using HRIS platforms such as SuccessFactors and employee survey tools such as Qualtrics.

• Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and compelling presentations for leaders.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

• High attention to detail and ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

• Demonstrated commitment to fostering inclusive, equitable, and engaging workplace experiences

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting DEI, culture, talent management, or employee engagement programs within a global organization.

• Knowledge of HR analytics, workforce reporting, and organizational effectiveness methodologies.

• Experience implementing AI-enabled solutions or digital transformation initiatives within HR functions.

• Experience partnering with cross-cultural and geographically diverse teams.

• Passion for developing inclusive workplaces and sustainable talent strategies.

## What We Offer You

• Competitive compensation including a variable annual incentive plan

• Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

• Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans, and optional insurances)

• Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, personal, sick, parental)

• Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Virtual Healthcare online

• Online training and career development opportunities

## Why Toronto

Toronto is Canada's largest city and a global center for business, innovation, and professional services. As home to Vale Base Metals' corporate offices and technical leadership teams, Toronto provides unique opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders while contributing to projects that support the responsible production of critical minerals essential for the energy transition.

## Include to Transform

At Vale Base Metals, we are committed to ensuring an inclusive work environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. Vale encourages everyone to express their ideas and opinions and values the plurality of individual profiles. We want our people to feel that all.

We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are critical to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or any other personal consideration that makes us different.
